hardWords.m: a feeling of not being sure

paragraphs.text: Al-Fatihah is a short prayer. It praises Allah, the Lord of all the worlds. He is very merciful. He is the King of the Day of Judgment. We worship only Him, and we ask only Him for help. We ask Him to guide us to the straight path.
Al-Baqarah begins. It says there is no doubt in this Book. It guides people who believe in the unseen. They pray, and they give from what Allah gave them. They are the successful ones.
Some people do not believe, even when they are warned. Other people say, "We believe," but it is not true. They try to trick others, but they only trick themselves.

1.title: The Opening Prayer and the Start of Al-Baqarah

hardWords.m: a short story that explains an idea
to pray to and serve Allah

paragraphs.text: Some people cause harm on the earth, but they say, "We only want to make things better." They say they believe, but in secret they laugh at the believers. They choose the wrong way over the right way. This is a bad trade.

Allah gives two examples. A man lights a fire, then the light goes away and he is left in the dark. Another group is caught in a storm with thunder and lightning. They are afraid and cannot see the way.

Then Allah calls all people to worship Him. He made the earth and the sky, and He sends rain and food. If people doubt the Quran, they cannot make anything like it. There is good news for people who believe and do good deeds.

2.title: People Who Say One Thing and Do Another

hardWords.m: thinking you are better than others
being sorry and turning back to Allah

paragraphs.text: Allah gave you life. You will die and live again. Then you will return to Him. He made all things on earth for you. He knows everything.
Allah told the angels about someone in charge on earth. He taught Adam the names of all things. The angels did not know them. Adam told them the names.

The angels bowed to Adam, but Iblees was proud and refused. Adam and his wife lived in Paradise. Satan made them slip. Allah accepted Adam's repentance. People who follow Allah's guidance will have no fear.
Allah speaks to the Children of Israel. Remember His gifts and keep your promise. Do not mix truth with lies. Pray and give zakah. Do not tell others to do good and forget yourselves.

3.title: Adam, the Angels, and Allah's Guidance

paragraphs.text: Seek help with patience and prayer. This is hard, except for humble people. They know they will meet their Lord. Allah reminds the Children of Israel of His favor. Fear a Day when no soul can help another soul.

Allah saved them from Pharaoh's people, who hurt them badly. Allah split the sea and saved them. Pharaoh's people drowned. Moses was away for forty nights, and the people worshipped a calf. Allah forgave them. Moses told them to repent. Some said they must see Allah first. A thunderbolt took them. Then Allah gave them life again.

Allah gave them shade, manna and quails. He told them to enter a city humbly. Some changed the words, so punishment came. Moses hit a stone, and twelve springs came out. They asked for onions and other plants. They chose less over better. They kept disobeying, so Allah's anger came upon them.

4.title: Patience, Prayer, and Allah's Gifts to Israel

hardWords.m: something good you get for good work
to kill an animal for food

paragraphs.text: Those who believe in Allah and the Last Day are rewarded. This includes Jews, Christians and Sabeans who believed and did good. They will have no fear or sadness. Allah took a promise from the Children of Israel. He raised the mountain over them. They turned away, but Allah was kind to them. Some broke the Sabbath rule. They became a lesson for others.

Moses told his people to slaughter a cow. They asked many questions about it. Allah told them its age and color. At last, they slaughtered it, but almost did not. A man was killed, and people argued about it. Allah showed how He brings the dead to life.

After this, their hearts became hard like stones. Some people heard Allah's words and changed them. Allah knows what people hide and what they show. Some people do not know the Scripture. They only guess.

5.title: A Promise, a Cow, and Hard Hearts

hardWords.m: children with no father or mother
people sent by Allah with His message
thinking you are better than others

paragraphs.text: Some people write a book and say it is from Allah. They do it for a small price. Whoever does evil will stay in the Fire forever. Those who believe and do good will stay in Paradise forever.

Allah took a promise from the Children of Israel. Worship only Allah. Be good to parents, relatives, orphans and the poor. Speak good words, pray and give zakah. Most of them turned away. They hurt and pushed out their own people. They followed only part of the Scripture. They chose this world over the Hereafter.
Allah gave Moses the Torah and sent more messengers. He gave Jesus clear proofs. But many people were proud and rejected messengers. Allah sent a Book, but they did not believe it.
They say the Hereafter is only for them. They never wish for death. They want a very long life. Allah sees what they do.

6.title: Broken Promises and Love of This Life

hardWords.m: help to find the right way
wanting what others have and feeling bad
not doing what you are told

paragraphs.text: Gabriel brought the Quran down by Allah's permission. It agrees with the books before it. It is guidance and good news for believers. Allah sent clear signs. Only very disobedient people deny them. Some people broke every promise. They threw Allah's Book behind their backs.
They followed what the devils taught in Solomon's time. The devils taught magic. Two angels said, "We are a test." Magic harms only if Allah allows. Buyers of magic lose the Hereafter.
Some people feel envy toward the believers. But Allah gives mercy to whom He wills. Allah can do all things. Believers should forgive, pray and give zakah. Every good deed is kept with Allah.
Some say only their group enters Paradise. Ask them for proof. Whoever submits to Allah and does good gets a reward. They will have no fear or sadness. Allah will judge them on the Last Day.

7.title: Clear Signs, Promises Broken, and True Reward

hardWords.m: help to find the right way
checked how strong or good someone is
very clean, with nothing bad in it

paragraphs.text: Some people stop Allah's name in His mosques. They try to destroy them. They will have shame here and punishment later. The east and the west belong to Allah. Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah. Some say Allah has a son. Allah is far above that. Everything is His. He only says "Be," and it is.

Some ask why Allah does not speak. Allah sent the Prophet with the truth. He brings good news and warning. Allah's guidance is the true guidance. Children of Israel, remember Allah's favor. Fear a Day when no soul can help another.

Allah tested Abraham, and he passed. Allah made him a leader. But His promise is not for wrongdoers. Abraham and Ishmael built the House. They kept it pure. They prayed, "Our Lord, accept this from us." They asked for a messenger. Only a fool turns from Abraham's way.

hardWords.m: a group of people living together
not be sure something is true

paragraphs.text: Allah told Abraham, "Submit." He said, "I submit to the Lord of the worlds." Abraham and Jacob told their sons, "Allah chose this religion for you. Die only as Muslims." As Jacob was dying, his sons promised to worship one God. That nation has passed. Each person gets what they earned.

Some people say, "Be Jews or Christians to be guided." Say, "We follow the way of Abraham. He did not worship others with Allah." Believers have faith in Allah and in all His prophets. They make no difference between them. Our deeds are ours, and yours are yours.

Foolish people will ask why the qiblah changed. The east and the west belong to Allah. Allah made the believers a just community. The change showed who truly follows the Messenger. Now turn toward al-Masjid al-Haram in prayer. The truth is from your Lord. So never doubt it.

9.title: Abraham's Religion and the New Qiblah

hardWords.m: staying calm and strong in hard times
feel sorry and stop doing wrong

paragraphs.text: Each group faces its own direction. So race to do good. Turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram in prayer. Allah sent you a messenger from among you. He teaches you the Book and wisdom. Remember Allah, and He will remember you. Be grateful to Him.

Seek help through patience and prayer. Allah is with the patient. Those killed in Allah's way are not dead. They are alive. Allah will test people with fear, hunger and loss. The patient say, "We belong to Allah, and to Him we return." They receive blessings and mercy.
Safa and Marwah are signs of Allah. Pilgrims may walk between them.

Some people hide Allah's clear guidance. They are under a curse, unless they repent. Allah is one God, the Merciful. The sky, the earth, night and day, ships, rain and wind are signs for people who think.

10.title: Patience, Prayer and the Signs of Allah

hardWords.m: feeling sad about what you did

paragraphs.text: Some people take others as equals to Allah. But believers love Allah more. On that Day, leaders will turn away from their followers. The followers will be full of regret. They will not leave the Fire.

Eat good and lawful food. Do not follow Satan. He is your clear enemy. Some people only follow their fathers' ways. A few foods are forbidden. A person forced by need has no sin. Those who hide the Book will get a painful punishment.
Turning east or west is not true goodness. Goodness is to believe in Allah and the Last Day. It is to help people in need, pray, give zakah, keep promises and be patient.
Allah set a law of fair justice for murder. Forgiving is a mercy from Allah. Before death, leave a fair will for parents and relatives. Changing a will is a sin.

11.title: True Goodness, Good Food and Fair Justice

hardWords.m: giving help or money to the poor
things you take with you for a trip

paragraphs.text: Fixing an unfair will is no sin. Fasting is written for believers, as for those before. Fast for set days. The sick and travelers can fast on other days. The Quran came down in Ramadan. Allah wants ease for you, not hardship. Allah is near. He answers those who call Him.
On Ramadan nights, husbands and wives may be together. Eat and drink until dawn appears. Then fast until sunset. Do not take people's wealth unfairly. New moons mark times for people and Hajj.
Fight those who fight you, but do not go too far. If they stop, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. Spend in Allah's way. Do good. Allah loves those who do good.
Complete Hajj and umrah for Allah. The sick can fast, give charity or offer an animal. During Hajj, avoid sin and arguing. The best supplies are fear of Allah. Remember Allah after leaving Arafat.

12.title: Fasting in Ramadan, Fair Limits and Hajj

hardWords.m: when a wrong is let go
to laugh at someone in a bad way

paragraphs.text: After Hajj, ask Allah for forgiveness. Remember Allah very much. Some people ask only for this world. They get nothing in the Hereafter. Others ask for good in both lives. They will get what they earned. Leaving after two or three days is no sin. You will all return to Allah.
Some people say sweet words, but they are enemies. They spread harm and destroy crops. Allah does not like this. Others give themselves to please Allah.
Believers, enter Islam fully. Do not follow Satan. He is your clear enemy. Disbelievers love this world. They mock believers.

People were once one group. Allah sent prophets and the Book. He guided the believers to the truth. People before you faced hard tests. Allah's help is near. Spend on parents, relatives, orphans, the poor and travelers. Allah knows the good you do.

13.title: Remembering Allah, True Faith and Spending

hardWords.m: playing games to win money by luck
strong promises, often by Allah's name

paragraphs.text: Fighting was made a duty, though people dislike it. You may hate a good thing. You may love a bad thing. Allah knows, and you do not. Fighting in the sacred month is a great sin. But stopping people from Allah's way is worse. Believers who strive hope for Allah's mercy.
People ask about wine and gambling. They have some benefit, but more sin. Spend what is more than you need. Treat orphans well. They are your brothers.

Do not marry people who worship others until they believe. Keep away from wives during their monthly period. Allah loves those who repent and stay clean. Do not use oaths to avoid doing good. Allah blames what the heart intends.
Then come rules about divorce and waiting time. Husbands must keep wives kindly or let them go kindly. These are the limits of Allah. Do not cross them. Remember Allah's favor.

14.title: Hard Duties, Good Choices and Family Rules

hardWords.m: a woman whose husband has died
food, money and things a person needs
to make something many times bigger
able to wait and stay calm in hard times

paragraphs.text: Mothers may feed babies for two full years. The father gives food and clothes fairly. No one carries more than they can. A widow waits four months and ten days. Do not marry before her time ends. Do not forget kindness between you.
Guard your prayers, especially the middle prayer. Stand before Allah humbly. In danger, pray walking or riding.
Widows get support for one year. Divorced women get fair provision too. Allah makes His verses clear.
Some people ran from home, fearing death. Allah made them die, then gave them life. Who will give Allah a good loan? He will multiply it.

The Children of Israel asked their prophet for a king. Allah chose Saul. The people said he was not rich. But Allah gave him knowledge and strength. Saul tested his soldiers with a river. Most drank from it. The few believers said, "Allah is with the patient."

15.title: Family Rights, Prayer and King Saul

hardWords.m: giving money or help to people in need

paragraphs.text: The believers faced Goliath and his army. They asked Allah for patience and victory, and they won. David killed Goliath. Allah made David a king and a prophet. He gave Jesus clear proofs.
Spend from what Allah gives you. A Day is coming with no trade. Allah is the Ever-Living. He never sleeps. There is no force in religion. Allah brings believers out of darkness into light.

A king argued with Abraham about Allah. Abraham said, "Allah brings the sun from the east." The king had no answer. Another man passed a ruined town. He died for one hundred years. Then Allah raised him. Abraham asked to see how Allah gives life to the dead.
Spending for Allah is like one seed. It grows seven hundred grains. Do not hurt people after you give. Kind words are better than hurtful charity. Giving to show off is lost, like washed dust.

hardWords.m: Allah letting go of your wrong acts
extra money taken back on a loan
people who see something and can tell about it
something you give to keep as a promise

paragraphs.text: Give from the good things you earn. Do not give bad things you would not take. Satan scares you with being poor. Allah promises forgiveness and more good. Allah gives wisdom to whom He wills. Giving openly is good. Giving to the poor in secret is better. Some poor people do not keep asking others. Allah knows all that you give. You will get it back in full.

Allah allows trade, but He forbids interest. Allah destroys interest. He makes charity grow. Stop taking interest, and fear Allah. If a person cannot pay, give him more time. Letting the debt go is even better. Remember the Day you return to Allah.

When you borrow for a set time, write it down. A writer should write it fairly. Bring witnesses. On a journey with no writer, take a deposit. Keep what people trust you with. Do not hide what you saw.

17.title: Giving, Interest and Writing Down Debts

hardWords.m: people sent by Allah with His message
for all time, with no end

paragraphs.text: All in the heavens and earth is for Allah. He knows what you show and what you hide. The believers believe in His angels, books and messengers. They say, "We hear and we obey." Allah does not give a soul more than it can carry. They pray, "Our Lord, forgive us if we forget. Have mercy on us."

Allah is the Ever-Living. There is no deity but Him. He sent down the Book with the truth. Before it, He sent the Torah and the Gospel. Some verses are clear. Others are not so clear. Only Allah knows their true meaning. People of firm knowledge say, "All of it is from our Lord."

Wealth and children will not help the disbelievers. People love gold, horses, cattle and land. These are only joys of this world. Those who fear Allah will have gardens with rivers. They will live there forever.

18.title: Allah Knows All and Sent the Book

hardWords.m: calm when waiting or in trouble

paragraphs.text: Good believers pray to Allah. They ask Him to forgive them. They are patient and honest. They ask forgiveness before dawn. Allah says there is no god but Him. The true religion with Allah is Islam. If people argue, the Prophet only has to deliver the message.

Some people reject Allah's signs. They even killed prophets. Their deeds are lost, and no one will help them. Some turn away from Allah's Book. They think the Fire will touch them only a few days. But on the Day, every soul will get what it earned.
Allah owns all power. He gives honor and takes it away. He gives life from death. Believers should not choose disbelievers as close friends over believers. Allah knows what is hidden in hearts.
If you love Allah, follow the Prophet. Then Allah will love you and forgive you.

19.title: Allah Knows All and Gives Power

paragraphs.text: Allah chose Adam, Noah, and the families of Abraham and Imran. The wife of Imran made a promise. She gave her baby to serve Allah. The baby was a girl. She named her Mary. Allah accepted Mary and helped her grow well. Zechariah took care of her. He always found food with her, from Allah.

Zechariah prayed for a good child. The angels gave him good news of a son, John. Zechariah was old, and his wife could not have children. Allah does what He wills. His sign: he would not speak for three days.

The angels told Mary that Allah chose her and made her pure. They gave her good news of a son, Jesus, the Messiah. He would speak as a baby. Allah only says "Be," and it is. Jesus would be a messenger. By Allah's permission, he would heal the blind and give life to the dead.

20.title: Mary, Zechariah, and the Good News of Jesus

paragraphs.text: Jesus came to confirm the Torah. He made some forbidden things lawful. He said, "Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him." Some people did not believe. His disciples promised to help him for Allah.

The disbelievers made plans. But Allah is the best planner. Allah told Jesus He would raise him up to Himself. Allah will judge all people. Disbelievers will be punished. Believers who do good get full reward.
Jesus is like Adam. Allah made Adam from dust. He said "Be," and he was. Do not doubt this truth. If people still argue, both sides should pray. They ask Allah to curse the liars.
Allah calls the People of the Book to a fair word. Let us worship only Allah. Why do they argue about Abraham? The Torah and Gospel came after him. Allah knows, and they do not.

21.title: Jesus, His Helpers, and a Fair Word

hardWords.m: to lead someone the wrong way

paragraphs.text: Abraham was not a Jew or a Christian. He turned to the truth. He was a Muslim who submitted to Allah. His true followers are closest to him. Allah is the protector of the believers.
Some People of the Book want to mislead you. But they only mislead themselves. Why do they hide the truth they know? All bounty is in His hand. He gives it to whom He wills.

Some of them return a large trust. Others will not return even one coin. Allah loves those who keep their promise and fear Him. Some sell Allah's covenant for a small price. Their punishment is painful.

A prophet would never say, "Worship me." Allah took a promise from the prophets. They must support a messenger who confirms their Book. All in the heavens and earth submit to Allah. All will return to Him.

22.title: Abraham, Honest Trust, and the Prophets' Promise

hardWords.m: to be sorry and stop doing wrong
a holy journey to a special place

paragraphs.text: Say: We believe in Allah and what came to us. We believe in what came to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac and Jacob. We believe in what Moses, Jesus and the prophets were given. We make no difference between them. Whoever wants a religion other than Islam will lose.

Some saw clear signs but turned away. Allah does not guide the wrongdoers. Their punishment will not be made lighter. But Allah forgives those who repent and do good. One who dies disbelieving cannot save himself with gold. You reach the good by spending what you love.
Follow the religion of Abraham. The first House of worship is at Makkah. It is blessed and a guidance. Whoever enters it is safe. People who are able must make the pilgrimage there.
Why do the People of the Scripture deny Allah's verses? Allah sees what they do. Some want to turn believers back to disbelief.

23.title: One Faith, Giving, and the House at Makkah

24.title: Hold Together, and the Best Nation

paragraphs.text: How can you disbelieve? Allah's verses are read to you. Fear Allah truly. Die only as Muslims. Hold firmly to the rope of Allah together. Do not become divided. You were enemies, but He joined your hearts. You became brothers by His favor. Let a group of you invite to good and forbid wrong.

On the Day, some faces will turn white. Others will turn black. The black faces will taste punishment for disbelief. The white faces will stay in Allah's mercy forever. All in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah.

You are the best nation for mankind. You command right and believe in Allah. Some People of the Scripture believe. But most of them disobey. Some of them pray at night and hurry to good deeds. The wealth of disbelievers will not help them. Their spending is like a frosty wind. It destroys a harvest.

25.title: False Friends, Help at Badr, and Forgiving Anger

paragraphs.text: Do not take outsiders as close friends. They wish you hardship. Hatred comes from their mouths. You love them, but they do not love you. When alone, they bite their fingers in rage. Be patient and fear Allah. Then their plot will not harm you.

The Prophet placed the believers for battle. Two groups almost lost courage. But Allah was their ally. Allah gave you victory at Badr when you were few. He promised help from thousands of angels. This was good news to calm your hearts. Victory comes only from Allah. He forgives and punishes whom He wills.

Do not take usury, doubled again and again. Obey Allah and the Messenger. Hurry to forgiveness and a garden as wide as the heavens. It is for those who give in ease and hardship. They control their anger and forgive people. Allah loves those who do good.

hardWords.m: extra money taken on a loan

26.title: Do Not Weaken: Lessons After a Wound

paragraphs.text: Some do wrong, then remember Allah and ask forgiveness. Who forgives sins except Allah? Their reward is forgiveness and gardens with rivers. This Quran is clear guidance for those who fear Allah.

Do not weaken or be sad. You will be higher if you truly believe. You were wounded, but the others were wounded too. Allah changes the days among people. This shows who truly believes. Paradise is not reached without a test.

Muhammad is only a messenger. Other messengers passed before him. Would you turn back if he died? No soul dies without Allah's permission. Many prophets and their followers did not weaken. "Our Lord, forgive us," they prayed. Allah rewarded them in this world and the Hereafter.
If you obey the disbelievers, they will turn you back. Allah is your protector and the best helper. He will put terror in the hearts of disbelievers.

27.title: A Test in Battle and the Gentle Prophet

paragraphs.text: Allah kept His promise in the battle. Then you lost courage and argued. You disobeyed after seeing what you loved. Allah tested you, and He forgave you. You fled while the Messenger called you. Then Allah sent calm sleep upon some of you. Satan made some slip, but Allah forgave them.
Do not talk like the disbelievers about death. Allah gives life and death. His forgiveness is better than all they collect.

By Allah's mercy, the Prophet was gentle with people. If he were harsh, they would leave him. So forgive them and consult them. Then trust in Allah. Allah sent the believers a Messenger from among them. He teaches them the Book and wisdom.
When disaster struck you, you asked why. It came from yourselves. It showed the true believers and the hypocrites. The hypocrites said what was not in their hearts.

hardWords.m: people who only pretend to believe

28.title: Alive With Their Lord, and Every Soul Dies

paragraphs.text: Do not think those killed in Allah's cause are dead. They are alive with their Lord. They receive provision and are happy. Some believers answered Allah even after injury. People told them to fear the army against them. But their faith grew stronger. "Allah is enough for us," they said. Satan makes you fear his friends. Fear Allah instead.

Do not be sad about those who rush to disbelief. They cannot harm Allah. More time only lets them grow in sin. Allah will separate the bad from the good. Some hold back what Allah gave them. That is worse for them.

"Allah is poor, and we are rich," some said. Allah recorded their words. Messengers before were also denied. Every soul will taste death. Full reward comes on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever is saved from the Fire has truly won. This worldly life is only a deceiving enjoyment.

hardWords.m: the inner self of a person

29.title: Signs in Creation, and One Soul for All

paragraphs.text: You will be tested in your wealth and yourselves. Be patient and fear Allah. Those given the Scripture promised to make it clear. But they sold it for a small price. Some love praise for what they did not do. They will not escape punishment.

The heavens, the earth, night and day are signs. Wise people remember Allah and think about creation. "Our Lord, You did not create this for nothing," they say. Allah answers them. No good work is lost, from a man or a woman.
Do not be fooled by the disbelievers moving freely. Their enjoyment is small, then Hell. The righteous will have gardens with rivers. Be patient, stay firm, and fear Allah.
O mankind, fear your Lord. He created you from one soul. From it He made its mate. Give orphans their property.

hardWords.m: a partner, one of a pair

30.title: Orphans, Shares of Inheritance, and True Repentance

paragraphs.text: If you fear being unfair to orphan girls, marry other women. You may marry two, three, or four. If you fear injustice, marry only one. Give women their marriage gifts. Give orphans their property when they are wise.

Men and women both get a share from parents and relatives. Those who eat orphans' property unjustly eat fire. Allah sets the shares for children, parents and spouses. Debts and wills come first. These are Allah's limits. Whoever obeys enters gardens. Whoever disobeys enters the Fire.
For immoral acts, four witnesses are needed. Allah accepts those who repent soon after doing wrong. Repentance at the moment of death is not accepted.
Do not take women as inheritance by force. Live with them in kindness. You may dislike something, but Allah puts much good in it.

hardWords.m: what people get from someone who died

31.title: Marriage, Fair Trade, and Kindness to All

paragraphs.text: Do not marry the women your fathers married. Allah names the women you may not marry. These include mothers, daughters, sisters and aunts. Others are lawful through marriage with a gift. Those without means may marry believing slave girls.

Allah wants to accept your repentance and make things lighter. Mankind was created weak. Do not take wealth unjustly. Trade only by agreement. Avoid the major sins, and Allah will remove your small sins.
Do not wish for what Allah gave others. Men and women each get what they earn. Men are in charge of women. Steps are given if a husband fears arrogance. For a split, send a helper from each family.
Worship Allah alone. Be good to parents, relatives, orphans, the poor, neighbors and travelers. Allah does not like proud boasters or stingy people.

hardWords.m: not wanting to give or spend

32.title: Clean for Prayer, and Pure Hearts

paragraphs.text: Some spend only to be seen by people. Allah is never unjust, not even by an atom's weight. He multiplies good deeds. On that Day, disbelievers will wish the earth covered them.
Do not come to prayer while drunk. In a state of janabah, wash your whole body first. If there is no water, use clean earth. Wipe your faces and hands with it.

Some of those given the Scripture buy error. Some twist words and mock the religion. Saying "we hear and obey" would be better. Allah does not forgive associating others with Him. He forgives less than that for whom He wills.

Some believe in false objects of worship. They say the disbelievers are better guided. Allah has cursed them. Do they envy people for Allah's bounty? Allah gave Abraham's family the Scripture, wisdom and a great kingdom.

hardWords.m: to turn something out of its true shape
a land ruled by a king

33.title: Return Trusts, Judge Fairly, Obey the Messenger

paragraphs.text: Some believed, and some turned away. Those who deny Allah's verses will burn in the Fire. Believers who do good will live in gardens forever. They will have pure spouses and deep shade.
Allah commands you to return trusts to their owners. Judge between people with justice. Obey Allah, the Messenger, and those in authority. If you disagree, refer it to Allah and the Messenger.

Some claim belief but want to judge by Taghut. The hypocrites turn away from the Messenger. Then disaster strikes them, and they swear they meant good. Messengers are sent to be obeyed. They will not truly believe until they accept his judgment fully.
Following instructions would be better for them. Those who obey will be with the prophets, martyrs and righteous. What good companions they are! Believers, take care and go out in groups.

hardWords.m: things given to you to keep safe
the right to lead and give orders
to take a matter to someone to decide

34.title: Stand for the Weak, and Reflect on the Quran

paragraphs.text: Some stay behind from fighting. If disaster strikes you, they are glad they were absent. Let those who choose the Hereafter fight in Allah's cause. Why not fight for weak men, women and children? Satan's plan is always weak.
Some feared fighting as they fear Allah. This world's enjoyment is little. Death will find you, even in high towers. All things are from Allah. Good comes from Allah. Evil comes from yourself.
Whoever obeys the Messenger obeys Allah. Some promise obedience but plan otherwise at night. Do they not think about the Quran? If it were not from Allah, it would have many contradictions.
Encourage the believers. When you are greeted, greet back better or the same. There is no deity but Allah. He will gather you on the Day of Resurrection.

hardWords.m: things that disagree with each other
to give someone hope and push to act

35.title: Peace, Life, and Prayer in Times of Fear

paragraphs.text: Some wish you would disbelieve like them. Do not take them as allies. Do not fight those who offer peace.
A believer must never kill a believer, except by mistake. Then free a believing slave and pay the family. One who cannot do so must fast two months. Killing a believer on purpose leads to Hell.

Check carefully when you go out in Allah's cause. Do not deny the faith of one offering peace. Those who strive with wealth and lives are higher in rank. Some will say they were oppressed in the land. Was the earth not wide enough to move? Whoever emigrates for Allah will find space on earth.
You may shorten prayer when traveling in fear. In danger, pray in groups and keep your weapons. Remember Allah standing, sitting and lying down. Do not weaken in following the enemy.

hardWords.m: something wrong done not on purpose
leaves his home for another land

36.title: Do Not Defend Deceivers, and Satan's False Promises

paragraphs.text: Seek forgiveness from Allah. Do not argue for those who betray themselves. They hide from people, but not from Allah. Who will argue for them on the Day of Resurrection? Whoever does wrong and asks forgiveness finds Allah Merciful. A sinner earns sin against himself. Blaming an innocent person is a clear sin.

By Allah's favor, the Prophet was not misled. Allah taught him the Book and wisdom. Much secret talk has no good in it. But calling to charity and peace between people is good. Opposing the Messenger after guidance leads to Hell.

Allah does not forgive associating others with Him. Some call upon none but a rebellious Satan. Satan said he would mislead people. He stirs up false desires in them. His promises only deceive. Believers who do good will live in gardens forever. Allah's promise is true.

37.title: Not by Wishes: Justice, Peace, and Faith

paragraphs.text: Paradise does not come by wishes. Whoever does wrong will be paid for it. Any believer who does good enters Paradise, man or woman. The best religion is to submit to Allah and do good. Allah took Abraham as a close friend.
Allah gives rulings about women and orphan girls. A wife and husband may make peace. Peace is best. You cannot be fully equal between wives. But do not leave one hanging.
Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Allah. He needs nothing and is Praiseworthy. He could replace you with other people.

Stand firm for justice, even against yourselves or parents. Be just to rich and poor. Believe in Allah, His Messenger, and His books. Some believe, then disbelieve again and again. Hypocrites will have a painful punishment. They seek honor from disbelievers. But all honor belongs to Allah.

hardWords.m: official answers about what to do
to put another in its place

38.title: The Hypocrites, and Believing in All Messengers

paragraphs.text: Do not sit with those who mock Allah's verses. Hypocrites watch you. They claim to be with whoever wins. They try to deceive Allah. They pray lazily to be seen. They belong to neither side.

Do not take disbelievers as allies instead of believers. Hypocrites will be in the lowest part of the Fire. But those who repent and are sincere join the believers. Allah does not punish the grateful. Allah dislikes evil talk in public, except by the wronged. Allah Himself is Pardoning.
Some believe in some messengers and deny others. They are truly disbelievers. Those who believe in all messengers will be rewarded.

The People of the Scripture asked for a book from heaven. They asked Moses to show them Allah openly. They worshipped the calf after clear proofs. They broke their covenant and killed prophets. They spoke a great slander against Mary.

hardWords.m: without wanting to make an effort
false words to hurt someone's name

39.title: Jesus Was Raised Up, and Many Messengers

paragraphs.text: They claimed they killed Jesus, son of Mary. But they did not kill him or crucify him. Another was made to look like him. They follow only guesses. Allah raised him up to Himself.
For their wrongdoing, some good foods became unlawful for them. They took usury and ate wealth unjustly. But those firm in knowledge believe. Those who pray and give zakah will get a great reward.
Allah sent revelation to Muhammad as He did to Noah. He also sent it to Abraham, Ishmael, Jesus, Job and Jonah. Allah spoke directly to Moses. Messengers brought good news and warnings.

Do not go too far in religion. Jesus was a messenger of Allah and His word. Do not say "Three"; stop. Allah is only One. He is far above having a son. Jesus and the angels are not too proud to serve Allah.

hardWords.m: to kill by nailing on a cross

40.title: Keep Your Contracts: Food, Washing, and Justice

paragraphs.text: A clear proof and light have come from your Lord. Allah guides those who hold to Him. Allah gives a ruling on inheritance. It is for one with no children or parents. A sister gets half. Two sisters get two-thirds.

Believers, keep your contracts. Do not hunt while in ihram. Do not let hatred push you to wrong. Help each other in good, not in sin. Dead animals, blood and pork are forbidden. Today Allah has perfected your religion. The food of the People of the Scripture is lawful.
Before prayer, wash your face, arms and feet. Wipe your head. Allah does not want hardship for you. Be just, even to those you hate. Justice is nearer to righteousness.
Allah took a covenant from the Children of Israel. They broke it, and their hearts became hard. The Christians also forgot part of their covenant.

hardWords.m: promises or deals made with others

41.title: Moses and the Holy Land, Adam's Two Sons

paragraphs.text: Our Messenger came to the People of the Scripture. He came with light and a clear Book. Allah guides people to ways of peace. He brings them from darkness into light. Those who say Allah is Christ have disbelieved.

Moses told his people to enter the Holy Land. They feared a strong people there. Two men told them to trust Allah. But the people refused. "Go, you and your Lord, and fight," they said. So the land was forbidden to them for forty years. They wandered in the land.

Adam's two sons offered a sacrifice. Allah accepted it from only one. The other threatened to kill him. The first would not raise his hand to kill. But the other killed his brother. Allah sent a crow digging the ground. It showed him how to hide the body. He became full of regret.

42.title: One Life Is Like All Mankind

paragraphs.text: Killing one soul unjustly is like killing all mankind. Saving one is like saving all mankind. Those who fight Allah and His Messenger face hard penalties. Allah forgives those who repent before capture.
Fear Allah and seek ways to be near Him. The disbelievers cannot buy their way out. Cut off the thief's hand as a punishment. Allah forgives the one who repents and reforms.
Do not be sad about those who rush to disbelief. They say they believe only with their mouths. They listen eagerly to lies. If they come to you, judge with justice.

Allah sent down the Torah with guidance and light. Then Allah sent Jesus with the Gospel. Then He sent the Quran to confirm them. Judge by what Allah revealed. Allah gave each people a law and a way. So race to do good. All will return to Allah.

43.title: Allies of Allah and Those Who Mock

paragraphs.text: Who judges better than Allah? Do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. Some with sick hearts rush to them. Later they will be sorry. Their deeds become worthless.

If some leave their religion, Allah will bring others. He loves them, and they love Him. They strive for Allah and do not fear blame. Your ally is Allah, His Messenger and the believers. The party of Allah will win. Do not befriend those who mock your religion.
Some say they believe, but disbelief stays in their hearts. Many rush into sin and eat what is unlawful. Why do their scholars not stop them?
Some said that Allah's hand is chained. No, both His hands are open wide. He gives as He wills. If they had believed, they would enter Gardens of Pleasure. Some are fair, but many do evil.

hardWords.m: friends who help and support each other

44.title: The Messiah, the Messenger, and Tears of Truth

paragraphs.text: O Messenger, tell all that was revealed to you. Allah will protect you. Those who believe in Allah and do good have no fear. The Children of Israel broke their promise. They denied some messengers and killed others.
Those who say Allah is the Messiah have disbelieved. The Messiah himself told them to worship Allah. There is only one God. Jesus, son of Mary, was only a messenger. He and his mother both ate food.
David and Jesus cursed the disbelievers among the Children of Israel. They did not stop each other from wrong. So Allah is angry with them.
Some are hard enemies of the believers. Christians are the nearest to them in love. They are not arrogant. When they hear the revelation, their eyes fill with tears. They say that they believe.

hardWords.m: a title of Jesus, son of Mary
thinking you are better than others

45.title: Good Food, Oaths, and Staying Away from Wrong

paragraphs.text: They hope to enter Paradise with the righteous. Allah rewards them with gardens and rivers. Those who deny His signs go to Hellfire.

Do not forbid good things that Allah made lawful. Eat what is good and lawful. If you break a serious oath, there is a payment. Feed ten poor people, or clothe them, or free a slave. If you cannot, fast for three days. Intoxicants and gambling are from Satan. They bring hatred and turn you from prayer. So stay away from them. Obey Allah and the Messenger.
Do not hunt land animals in the state of ihram. Food from the sea is lawful for you. Allah made the Ka'bah, the Sacred House, a support for people. He knows all in the heavens and the earth.
Allah is severe in penalty, yet Forgiving and Merciful. Evil and good are not equal, even if evil is more.

hardWords.m: drinks or things that make you drunk

46.title: Witnesses, Jesus, and the Table from Heaven

paragraphs.text: Do not ask about things that may upset you. Some people asked before and then disbelieved. Some invent lies about Allah. They only follow their fathers' ways. Look after your own souls. Those who go astray cannot harm you.
When death comes near, two just men should witness the will. They swear by Allah to tell the truth. If they lie, two others take their place.

Allah will gather the messengers on that Day. He will remind Jesus of His favors. Jesus spoke to people as a baby in the cradle. By Allah's permission, he healed the blind and raised the dead. The disciples asked for a table of food from heaven. Allah sent it down with a warning.
Allah will ask Jesus about worship of him and his mother. Jesus will say he had no right to say that. He only told them to worship Allah.

hardWords.m: a small bed for a baby

47.title: The Creator of Heavens, Earth, Darkness and Light

paragraphs.text: Jesus will leave them to Allah, the Wise. On that Day, the truthful will gain from their truth. They will live in gardens forever. Allah is pleased with them. To Allah belong the heavens and the earth.

All praise is for Allah. He made the heavens, the earth, darkness and light. He created you from clay and set your time. He knows your secrets. Yet people turn away from His signs. Allah destroyed many nations before for their sins.
Even a written book from the sky would not convince them. They would call it magic. They ask for an angel to come. Messengers before were mocked too. Travel and see the end of the deniers.
Allah has written mercy upon Himself. He will gather all on the Day of Resurrection. He feeds and is not fed. The Prophet was told to be the first to submit.

hardWords.m: rising from death to new life

48.title: Lies on the Day and the Wish to Return

paragraphs.text: The Prophet fears the punishment of a great Day. Only Allah can remove harm. He is the Wise, the Aware. Allah is witness between the Prophet and the people. The Qur'an came to warn them. He is only one God.

No one is more unjust than one who lies about Allah. On that Day, some will be asked about their false partners. They will lie and deny it. Some listen but do not understand. They call the Qur'an old stories. They keep others away and only harm themselves.

At the Fire, they will wish to return to earth. But they would do the same again. They said there is only this life. Before their Lord, they will admit the truth. They will feel great regret. They carry their burdens on their backs.

hardWords.m: to say that something is true

49.title: Patience of Messengers and Lessons from Past Nations

paragraphs.text: This worldly life is only play and fun. The Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah. Do not be sad at their words. Messengers before you were denied too. They were patient until help came. No one can change Allah's words. Only those who hear will answer.
They ask for a sign. Allah is able to send one. Every animal and bird lives in communities like you. Nothing is left out of the Record. In hard times, people call on Allah alone.

Allah tested past nations with poverty and hardship. But their hearts grew hard. Satan made their deeds look good. Then Allah opened every good thing to them. While they were happy, He seized them suddenly. The wrongdoers were wiped out.
Who but Allah could return your hearing and sight? Messengers bring good news and warnings.

50.title: The Keys of the Unseen Are with Allah

paragraphs.text: Those who deny the verses will be punished. The Prophet does not claim to know the unseen. He is not an angel. He only follows what is revealed. Warn people with the Qur'an. Do not send away those who call their Lord every day.

Greet the believers with peace. Allah has written mercy upon Himself. He forgives anyone who repents and corrects himself. The Prophet will not follow their desires. The decision belongs only to Allah.
Allah has the keys of the unseen. He knows all on land and sea. Not a leaf falls without His knowledge. He takes your souls at night. He wakes you again by day. Then you will return to Him.
Who saves you in the dark on land and sea? Allah saves you from every trouble. Yet you still worship others with Him. He can send punishment from above or below.

51.title: Abraham Looks at the Star, Moon and Sun

paragraphs.text: Your people denied the truth. Turn away from those who mock the verses. Leave those who treat religion as a game. The worldly life fooled them. Remind them with the Qur'an. No payment will save a soul then.
Should we call on what cannot help or harm us? Allah's guidance is the only guidance. We are told to submit to the Lord of the worlds. He says, "Be," and it is.

Abraham asked his father Azar why he worshipped idols. At night he saw a star. He called it his lord. But the star set and was gone. The same happened with the moon and the sun. He said he was free of what they worshipped. He turned to the One who made the heavens and earth.
His people argued with him. He did not fear what they worshipped. Those who believe and do no wrong will be safe.

52.title: The Guided Prophets and Signs in Nature

paragraphs.text: Allah gave Abraham a strong argument. He gave him Isaac and Jacob. He guided Noah before them. He also guided David, Solomon, Job, Joseph, Moses and Aaron. Zechariah, John, Jesus and Elias were righteous. Ishmael, Elisha, Jonah and Lot were chosen too. Follow their guidance. The Prophet asks no payment for this message.

Who sent down the Book that Moses brought? It was Allah. This Qur'an is a blessed Book. Who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah? At death, angels will take out the wrongdoers' souls. Each person comes to Allah alone.

Allah splits the seed and the date stone. He brings life out of death. He made the night for rest. He placed the stars to guide you. He sends rain and grows all plants. Look at the dates, grapes, olives and pomegranates. These are signs for believers.

hardWords.m: reasons that show something is true

53.title: He Sees All, and His Words Are True

paragraphs.text: Some make the jinn partners with Allah. They make up sons and daughters for Him. How can He have a son without a wife? He created all things. No eye can see Him, but He sees all.

Clear proofs have come from your Lord. Whoever sees helps himself. Follow what is revealed to you. Do not insult what others worship. Then they may insult Allah. They swear they will believe if a sign comes. But they would still not believe.
Even angels and the dead speaking would not change them. Every prophet has enemies from mankind and jinn. They whisper pretty, false words.
Should I seek a judge other than Allah? He sent down the Book in detail. His words are true and just. Most people on earth follow only guesses.

54.title: Food, Open Hearts, and the Home of Peace

paragraphs.text: Eat meat over which Allah's name was said. Allah has explained what is forbidden. Leave sin, both open and hidden. Do not eat meat without His name said over it.

One given life and light is not like one in darkness. Criminals plot in every city. But they only plot against themselves. Allah opens the heart of one He guides to Islam. The heart of the other feels tight. Those who remember will have the Home of Peace.

On that Day, Allah will gather the jinn and mankind. Messengers came to them with His verses. They will confess they were disbelievers. Allah does not destroy cities while the people are unaware. Everyone has ranks for their deeds. Allah needs nothing and is full of mercy. What you are promised is coming.

hardWords.m: to make a secret evil plan
to say openly that you did wrong

55.title: Made-Up Rules and What Allah Truly Forbids

paragraphs.text: The wrongdoers will not succeed. The polytheists gave Allah a share of crops and animals. They gave another share to their false partners. Some even killed their children. They made up rules about food. They lied about Allah and went astray.

Allah grows gardens, palm trees, crops, olives and pomegranates. Eat their fruit and give their due on harvest day. Do not waste. Do not follow the footsteps of Satan. They have no knowledge for their rules.

The forbidden foods are dead animals, poured blood and pig meat. Meat given to other than Allah is also forbidden. One who is forced has no sin. They say Allah willed their wrong. But they only follow guesses.
Do not worship anything with Allah. Be good to parents. Do not kill children because of poverty. Stay away from shameful deeds. Do not take a life without right.

hardWords.m: the time of cutting and gathering crops

56.title: The Straight Path and the Way of Abraham

paragraphs.text: Protect the orphan's wealth. Give full measure and weight. Allah asks of each soul only what it can do. Be fair when you speak, even about family. Follow the straight path of Allah.

Allah gave Moses the Scripture as guidance and mercy. This Qur'an is also a blessed Book. Now no one can say the Book never came. Do not divide your religion into groups. A good deed earns ten times its reward. An evil deed earns only its like.

The Prophet follows the way of Abraham. His prayer, sacrifice, life and death are all for Allah. No soul carries another's burden. Allah made you successors on the earth. He tests you with what He gives.
Alif, Lam, Meem, Sad. This Book was sent to warn and remind. Follow what your Lord has revealed.

57.title: The Scales of Deeds and the Pride of Iblees

paragraphs.text: Allah destroyed many cities at night or at noon. Then they said they were wrongdoers. Allah will question the people and the messengers. Deeds will be weighed on that Day. Those with heavy scales will succeed. Allah gave you a place and a living on earth. But few of you are grateful.

The angels bowed to Adam, except Iblees. He said he was better, made from fire. Adam was made from clay. Allah sent him out of Paradise for his pride. Satan asked for time until the Day of Resurrection. He promised to sit on the straight path. He would come at people from every side. Allah will fill Hell with him and his followers.
Adam and his wife lived in Paradise. They were told not to go near one tree. But Satan whispered to them. He said the tree would make them angels or immortal.

58.title: Adam's Fall and the Best Clothing

paragraphs.text: Satan swore he was a sincere friend. He tricked them, and they ate from the tree. Their bodies became uncovered. They covered themselves with leaves. They asked their Lord for forgiveness and mercy. Allah sent them down to the earth. They will live and die there.

Allah gave clothing to cover and to beautify. But the clothing of righteousness is best. Children of Adam, do not let Satan trick you. He and his tribe see you, but you cannot see them. Allah does not order shameful deeds. He orders justice.
Dress well at every masjid. Eat and drink, but do not waste. Good things are for believers. Allah forbids sin, wrongdoing and lying about Him. Every nation has a fixed time.
Those who fear Allah will have no fear. Those who deny the verses will be in the Fire. At death, they will witness against themselves.

hardWords.m: set and not able to change

59.title: Paradise, the Fire, and the Wall Between

paragraphs.text: Nations will enter the Fire one after another. The later ones will blame the first. Each will get a double punishment. The proud deniers will not enter Paradise. That is, until a camel passes through a needle's eye.
Believers who do good will live in Paradise. Allah removes all bad feelings from their hearts. They will thank Allah for guiding them. They found Allah's promise true.

A wall stands between the two groups. Men on its high places know everyone by their marks. They greet the people of Paradise with peace. The people of the Fire will beg for water. But Allah has forbidden it to the disbelievers. They forgot this Day, so they will be forgotten.
Allah sent a clear Book as guidance and mercy. Your Lord created the heavens and earth in six days. Then He rose above the Throne. The sun, moon and stars obey His command.

hardWords.m: a thin metal tool for sewing

60.title: Rain, Noah, and Hud Call to Allah

paragraphs.text: Call on your Lord humbly and quietly. Do not cause corruption on the earth. Allah's mercy is near to those who do good. He sends winds with good news before rain. The rain brings life to dead land. In the same way, He will raise the dead.

Allah sent Noah to his people. He told them to worship Allah alone. The leaders said he was in clear error. Noah said he was a messenger from Allah. They denied him. Allah saved him and his followers in the ship. The deniers were drowned.

Allah sent Hud to the people of 'Aad. He also told them to worship Allah alone. Their leaders called him foolish and a liar. Hud said he was a trustworthy adviser. He reminded them of Allah's favors. They refused to leave what their fathers worshipped. Hud told them to wait.

61.title: Salih, Lot, and Shu'ayb Warn Their People

paragraphs.text: Allah saved the prophet and his followers by His mercy. Those who denied His signs were destroyed.

Allah sent Salih to Thamud. He told them to worship Allah alone. The she-camel of Allah was clear evidence. They must let her eat and not hurt her. He reminded them of Allah's favors. The arrogant leaders questioned the believers. Then the people cut down the she-camel and defied their Lord. So an earthquake seized them. Salih turned away. He had given them good advice.

Lot warned his people about a shameful act no one had done before. They went to men with desire instead of women. They wanted to drive Lot out. Allah saved him and his family, except his wife. Then a rain of stones fell on the criminals.

Shu'ayb was sent to Madyan. He told them to worship Allah and give full measure and weight. They must not cheat or spread corruption. He asked them to be patient until Allah judges. But the arrogant leaders threatened to drive him out, unless he returned to their religion.

hardWords.m: something that shows what is true
too proud; thinking you are better than others
very bad, something to be ashamed of

paragraphs.text: Shu'ayb said returning to their religion would be a lie against Allah. "We rely on Allah," he said. Then an earthquake seized the deniers, and they fell dead in their homes. It was as if they had never lived there. Shu'ayb turned away. He had given them the message, so he would not grieve for them.

Allah tested every city that denied its prophet. He sent poverty and hardship so they might become humble. Then He gave them good times. But they did not learn, so Allah seized them suddenly. If the people of the cities had believed, He would have opened blessings from the sky and the earth. No one feels safe from Allah's plan except the losers. Allah seals the hearts of the disbelievers. Most of them did not keep their promise.

Then Allah sent Moses with His signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs. Moses said, "I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds." He would only speak the truth about Allah. He asked Pharaoh to let the Children of Israel go with him.

hardWords.bn: মোহর মেরে দেন / বন্ধ করে দেন

63.title: Moses and the Magicians of Pharaoh

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh asked Moses to show a sign. Moses threw his staff, and it became a clear serpent. He drew out his hand, and it shone white for all to see. Pharaoh's chiefs said, "This is a skilled magician. He wants to drive you out of your land." They told Pharaoh to wait. He should send men to the cities to gather every skilled magician.

The magicians came to Pharaoh. They asked for a reward if they won. Pharaoh promised a reward and a place close to him. The magicians asked Moses who would throw first. Moses said, "Throw." Their magic tricked the people's eyes and filled them with fear. It was a great show of magic. Then Allah told Moses to throw his staff. At once it swallowed their false tricks. The truth became clear, and their work came to nothing. Pharaoh and his people were defeated and made low.
Then the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We believe in the Lord of the worlds, the Lord of Moses and Aaron."

hardWords.m: took in through the mouth and ate
putting the forehead on the ground in worship

64.title: Pharaoh's Threats and the Signs of Punishment

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh threatened the magicians for believing without his permission. He said he would cut off their hands and feet and crucify them. They said, "We will return to our Lord." They prayed for patience and to die as Muslims.

Pharaoh said he would kill the sons of Moses' people. Moses told his people to seek help from Allah and be patient. The earth belongs to Allah. The best end is for the righteous. Perhaps Allah would destroy their enemy.

Allah seized Pharaoh's people with years of famine and few fruits. When bad came, they blamed Moses. So Allah sent the flood, locusts, lice, frogs, and blood. They begged Moses to pray and promised to believe. But when the punishment was removed, they broke their word. So Allah drowned them in the sea.

Allah gave the oppressed people the blessed lands in the east and west, because of their patience. He destroyed what Pharaoh had built. After crossing the sea, the Children of Israel saw people devoted to idols. They asked Moses for an idol like those. Moses said, "You are behaving ignorantly."

hardWords.m: a time when there is very little food

65.title: Moses on the Mountain and the Golden Calf

paragraphs.text: Moses reminded his people that Allah had preferred them over the worlds. He had saved them from Pharaoh's cruel torment.

Allah set a meeting with Moses for forty nights. Aaron took his place among the people. Moses asked to see Allah. Allah told him to look at the mountain. When Allah appeared to it, the mountain became flat. Moses fell unconscious. When he woke, he repented. Allah gave him tablets with guidance for all things.

Meanwhile, his people made a calf from their ornaments. It could not speak or guide. Moses came back angry and sad. He threw down the tablets and pulled his brother by the head. Aaron said the people had nearly killed him. Moses asked forgiveness for both of them. Allah forgives those who repent and believe.

Moses took up the tablets again and chose seventy men. An earthquake seized them, and he begged for mercy. Allah's mercy covers all things. It is for those who fear Him, give zakah, and believe. They follow the unlettered Prophet, who is written in the Torah and the Gospel. He orders what is right and forbids what is wrong.

hardWords.m: not awake; not able to see or feel
flat pieces of stone with writing on them
things worn for beauty, like jewelry
not taught to read or write

66.title: Twelve Tribes, the Sabbath, and Adam's Children

paragraphs.text: The Prophet is told to say he is Allah's Messenger to all people. Allah owns the heavens and the earth. He gives life and death. So believe in Him and His Messenger. Among Moses' people, a group guides by truth and acts with justice.

Allah divided the Children of Israel into twelve tribes. Moses struck a stone with his staff, and twelve springs burst out. Allah shaded them with clouds and gave them manna and quails. But the wrongdoers changed the words they were told to say. So a punishment came from the sky.

A town by the sea broke the rule of the Sabbath. Their fish came openly only on the Sabbath. Allah saved those who forbade evil. He made the wrongdoers despised apes. Allah is quick in penalty, yet Forgiving and Merciful.

Some of them were righteous, and some were not. Later people took the Scripture but chased worldly goods. The Hereafter is better for those who fear Allah. Allah also took a promise from the children of Adam. He asked, "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes." So no one can say they did not know.

hardWords.m: places where water comes out of the ground
a holy day of rest each week

67.title: Blind Hearts, the Hour, and False Partners

paragraphs.text: A man was given knowledge of Allah's signs, but he left them. Satan followed him, and he followed his own desires. He is like a dog that pants whether you chase it or leave it. So are those who deny Allah's signs. Whoever Allah guides is truly guided.

Many jinn and humans have hearts, eyes, and ears that they do not use. They are like cattle, or even more lost. Allah has the best names, so call on Him by them. Allah gives time to deniers, but His plan is firm. The Prophet is not mad. He is a clear warner.

People ask about the Hour. Only Allah knows its time. It will come suddenly. The Prophet has no power to help or harm himself, except as Allah wills. He does not know the unseen. He is only a warner and a bringer of good news.

Allah created people from one soul, and from it its mate. When a couple expects a child, they pray to Allah for a good one. But when He gives them one, they set up partners with Him. Allah is far above what they associate with Him. Those partners cannot create anything.

hardWords.m: a person who warns others of danger
join others with Allah in worship

68.title: Helpless Idols, Remembering Allah, and True Believers

paragraphs.text: The false deities cannot help those who call on them. They cannot even help themselves. They are servants, just like the people who call on them. They have no feet to walk or hands to strike. They have no eyes to see or ears to hear. The Prophet says, "My protector is Allah, who sent down the Book." He is the ally of the righteous.

Accept what people give freely, order what is good, and turn away from the ignorant. If Satan whispers evil to you, seek refuge in Allah. Those who fear Allah remember Him and then see clearly. The Qur'an is light, guidance, and mercy. When it is recited, listen and pay attention. Remember your Lord within yourself, morning and evening, with humility. Those near your Lord are never too proud to worship Him.

People asked the Prophet about the spoils of war. The decision belongs to Allah and the Messenger. So fear Allah and make peace among yourselves. True believers feel fear in their hearts when Allah is mentioned. His verses increase their faith, and they rely on their Lord.

hardWords.m: things people wrongly worship as gods
things taken from the enemy in war

69.title: Angels, Rain, and Help in Battle

paragraphs.text: True believers pray and spend from what Allah gives them. They will have high ranks, forgiveness, and noble provision.

Some believers did not want to go out with the Prophet. They argued about the truth, as if they were being driven to death. Allah promised them one of two groups. They wished for the unarmed group. But Allah wanted to establish the truth and end falsehood. When they asked for help, Allah sent a thousand angels. This was good news to calm their hearts. Victory comes only from Allah.

Allah covered them with sleep as a sign of security. He sent rain to purify them and make their feet firm. He told the angels to strengthen the believers. He would cast terror into the hearts of the disbelievers, because they opposed Allah and His Messenger.

Believers must not turn their backs and run in battle, unless it is a plan. Whoever runs away earns Allah's anger. It was really Allah who struck the enemy, to test the believers with a good test. He weakens the plots of the disbelievers. Their large army will not help them. Allah is with the believers.

hardWords.m: something that is not true; lies

70.title: Answer the Call, and Allah Is the Best Planner

paragraphs.text: Obey Allah and His Messenger. Do not be like those who say they hear but do not listen. The worst creatures before Allah are those who do not use reason.

Answer Allah and the Messenger when he calls you to what gives you life. Allah comes between a person and his heart. Remember when you were few and weak, and Allah gave you shelter and help. Do not betray Allah, the Messenger, or your trusts. Your wealth and children are only a test. If you fear Allah, He will give you a criterion, remove your bad deeds, and forgive you.

The disbelievers plotted to hold, kill, or drive out the Prophet. But Allah is the best of planners. They called the verses old legends. They even asked Allah to rain stones on them. But Allah would not punish them while the Prophet was among them, or while they asked forgiveness. Yet they blocked people from al-Masjid al-Haram. Their prayer there was only whistling and clapping. They spend their wealth to turn people from Allah's way. It will become a regret for them.

hardWords.m: a way to tell right from wrong
old stories that may not be true
making a high sound by blowing through the lips

71.title: Stand Firm When the Two Armies Meet

paragraphs.text: Allah will separate the wicked from the good. If the disbelievers stop, their past will be forgiven. If they return, the way of earlier peoples is known. Fight until there is no fitnah and all religion is for Allah. He is the best protector and helper.

One fifth of war booty is for Allah, the Messenger, relatives, orphans, the needy, and travelers. Allah showed the enemy as few in the Prophet's dream. Otherwise the believers would have lost courage and argued. Allah made each side look few to the other. This was so that His plan would be done.

When you meet the enemy, stand firm and remember Allah often. Obey Allah and His Messenger and do not argue, or you will lose strength. Do not be like those who left home proudly, to be seen by people. Satan made their deeds look good and promised to protect them. But when the armies met, he ran away.
The angels strike the faces and backs of disbelievers at death. Allah is never unjust to His servants. He does not change a favor He gave a people until they change what is in themselves.

hardWords.m: things taken from the enemy after war

paragraphs.text: Like Pharaoh's people, those who denied Allah's signs were destroyed for their sins. The worst creatures are the disbelievers who break their treaties every time. If you fear betrayal from a people, openly return the treaty to them. Allah does not like traitors.

Prepare whatever strength you can to frighten the enemy. Whatever you spend for Allah will be repaid in full. But if they lean toward peace, then lean toward it too and rely on Allah. Allah is enough for the Prophet. He brought the believers' hearts together. Even all the wealth on earth could not have done that.

Allah told the Prophet to urge the believers to fight. Twenty patient believers could defeat two hundred. Then Allah made it lighter, because He knew their weakness. Now one hundred patient believers could defeat two hundred. Allah is with the patient.

Some wanted worldly gain from captives, but Allah wants the Hereafter for them. Without Allah's earlier decree, they would have been punished. So enjoy the lawful booty and fear Allah. Tell the captives that if their hearts hold good, Allah will give them better and forgive them.

hardWords.bn: প্রতিদান দেওয়া হবে / ফেরত দেওয়া হবে

73.title: Allies in Faith and a Declaration to Polytheists

paragraphs.text: If the captives plan betrayal, Allah will give the believers power over them. Those who believed, emigrated, and strove for Allah are allies of one another. So are those who gave them shelter and help. They are the true believers, with forgiveness and noble provision. Believers who did not emigrate should still be helped in religion, but not against a people with a treaty. Blood relatives have more right in Allah's decree.

Allah and His Messenger make a declaration to the polytheists with treaties. They may travel freely in the land for four months. Treaties with those who kept them must be completed. When the sacred months pass, the believers are told to fight the others. But if they repent, pray, and give zakah, let them go. If one asks for protection, give it, so he may hear Allah's words.

Stay upright with those who stay upright with you. But many others would not respect kinship or promises if they gained power. They please you with their mouths, but their hearts refuse. If they repent, pray, and give zakah, they are your brothers in religion. If they break their oaths, fight the leaders of disbelief.

hardWords.m: left their home country to live in another place

74.title: Who Cares for Allah's Mosques, and Hunayn

paragraphs.text: Why not fight those who broke their oaths and tried to drive out the Messenger? He will punish them by the believers' hands and heal the believers' hearts. Allah will make clear who truly strives.

Polytheists should not care for the mosques of Allah. Only true believers should, those who pray, give zakah, and fear only Allah. Giving water to pilgrims is not equal to faith and striving in Allah's cause. Those who believe, emigrate, and strive with wealth and lives have a higher rank. They will have mercy and gardens forever.

Do not take fathers or brothers as allies if they prefer disbelief. Are family, wealth, trade, or homes dearer to you than Allah, His Messenger, and striving in His cause? Then wait for Allah's command.

On the day of Hunayn, their large number pleased them but did not help. They turned back and fled. Then Allah sent calm upon the Messenger and the believers, with soldiers they did not see. The polytheists may not come near al-Masjid al-Haram after this year. If the believers fear poverty, Allah will enrich them. Fight those given the Scripture who do not believe, until they pay the jizyah.

75.title: Allah's Light, the Sacred Months, and the Cave

paragraphs.text: The Jews say Ezra is the son of Allah. The Christians say the Messiah is the son of Allah. These are only words from their mouths. They took their scholars and monks as lords besides Allah. Yet they were told to worship only Him, with no deity but Him. They want to put out Allah's light with their mouths. But Allah will complete His light.

Many scholars and monks take people's wealth unjustly. Those who hoard gold and silver and do not spend it for Allah will have a painful punishment. It will be heated in Hell and pressed on their foreheads, sides, and backs.
With Allah, the year has twelve months, and four are sacred. Do not wrong yourselves in them. Moving the sacred months is an increase in disbelief.

Why do some believers hold heavily to the earth when called to go out for Allah? Worldly life is little next to the Hereafter. Allah already helped the Prophet when he was driven out. In the cave, he told his companion, "Do not grieve; Allah is with us." So go out, light or heavy, and strive. True believers do not ask to stay behind.

hardWords.m: religious men who live apart to worship
to collect and hide a lot of something
a friend who goes with you

76.title: The Hypocrites and Who Receives Zakah

paragraphs.text: If the hypocrites had gone out, they would have only added confusion. They wanted to cause trouble before. When good comes to the believers, it upsets them. When disaster comes, they turn away happy. Say, "Only what Allah has decreed for us will strike us." So let the believers rely on Allah.

The spending of the hypocrites will not be accepted. They disbelieve, come to prayer lazily, and give unwillingly. Do not be impressed by their wealth or children. They swear they are with you, but they are only afraid. Some complain about how charity is shared. They should be satisfied with what Allah and His Messenger give.
Zakah is for the poor, the needy, and those who collect it. It is also for bringing hearts together, freeing captives, those in debt, the cause of Allah, and the traveler. This is a duty from Allah.
Some hurt the Prophet and say, "He is an ear." He is an ear of goodness for them and a mercy for believers. Those who oppose Allah and His Messenger will have the fire of Hell forever.

hardWords.m: a state of not being clear or calm
without wanting to work or try

77.title: Hypocrites Who Mock, and Believers Who Help

paragraphs.text: The hypocrites fear a surah will expose their hearts. They say they were only joking. But mocking Allah, His verses, and His Messenger is disbelief. Hypocrite men and women order wrong and forbid right. They are stingy. They forgot Allah, so He forgot them. They are like earlier peoples who were stronger and richer, such as the people of Noah, 'Aad, and Thamud. Allah did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.
Believing men and women are allies of one another. They order right, forbid wrong, pray, give zakah, and obey Allah. They will have gardens with rivers. But Allah's approval is even greater.

The hypocrites swear they said nothing, but they spoke words of disbelief. Some promised Allah to give charity if He made them rich. When He did, they became stingy. So hypocrisy stayed in their hearts. They mock believers who can give only their effort. Even if the Prophet asked forgiveness for them seventy times, Allah would not forgive them. Those who stayed home said, "Do not go out in the heat." Say, "The fire of Hell is hotter."

hardWords.m: not wanting to give or share
showing faith outside but not having it inside

78.title: Those Who Stayed Behind and Those Excused

paragraphs.text: Let the hypocrites laugh a little and weep much. They will never go out with the Prophet again. Do not pray over any of them who dies, or stand at his grave. Do not be impressed by their wealth or children. When a surah called them to fight, the rich among them asked to stay behind. Their hearts were sealed.
But the Messenger and the believers strove with their wealth and lives. They will have all good things and gardens with rivers.

There is no blame on the weak, the sick, or those with nothing to spend, if they are sincere. Some came asking for animals to ride. When none were found, they turned back with tears, sad that they had nothing to give. The blame is only on the rich who ask to stay behind.

They will make excuses and swear when the believers return. Leave them alone; they are evil. Allah is not pleased with disobedient people. The bedouins are harder in disbelief and hypocrisy. Some see their spending as a loss and wait for bad times to strike you.

hardWords.m: honest and true in your heart
desert Arabs who move from place to place

79.title: A Mosque of Harm and a True Bargain

paragraphs.text: Some bedouins believe and see their spending as a way to come near Allah. He will admit them to His mercy. The first forerunners among the Muhajireen and the Ansar, and those who followed them well, are pleased with Allah, and He with them. Some around Madinah are hypocrites whom only Allah knows. Others admit their sins, mixing good and bad deeds. Perhaps Allah will forgive them.
Take charity from their wealth to purify them. Pray for them. Allah accepts repentance and charity. Say, "Do your deeds; Allah will see them." Others must wait for Allah's decision.

Some hypocrites built a mosque to cause harm and division. Never pray in it. A mosque built on righteousness from the first day is more worthy. A building on righteousness is better than one on the edge of a bank about to collapse.

Allah has bought the believers' lives and wealth in return for Paradise. This true promise is in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur'an. Believers repent, worship, praise, bow, and prostrate. They should not ask forgiveness for polytheists, even relatives. Abraham did so for his father only because of a promise. Abraham was compassionate and patient.

hardWords.m: the first ones to go ahead

80.title: Forgiveness for the Three and a Caring Messenger

paragraphs.text: Allah owns the heavens and the earth. Allah forgave the Prophet, the Muhajireen, and the Ansar who followed him in a hard hour. He also forgave the three who were left behind. The earth felt tight to them, and they knew there was no escape from Allah except to Him. Fear Allah and be with the truthful.

Every thirst, tiredness, or hunger in Allah's cause is written as a good deed. Every coin spent and every valley crossed is recorded. Not all believers should go out at once. Some should stay to learn the religion and warn their people.

When a surah comes down, it increases believers in faith. But it adds evil to those with diseased hearts. They are tested once or twice every year, but they do not repent. A Messenger has come from among you. Your suffering is hard for him. He is kind and merciful to believers. If they turn away, he says, "Allah is enough for me."
A new surah begins. People are amazed that a man among them received revelation. The disbelievers call him a magician. But your Lord created the heavens and the earth in six days. So worship Him.

81.title: Signs in the Sun, Moon, and Night

paragraphs.text: All will return to Allah. He begins creation and repeats it to reward the believers. Disbelievers will have scalding water to drink. Allah made the sun a bright light and the moon a reflected light. Its phases help you count the years. Night and day are signs for those who fear Allah. Believers will be in Gardens of Pleasure. Their greeting there will be, "Peace."

When harm touches man, he calls on Allah lying down, sitting, or standing. When it is removed, he acts as if he never called. Allah destroyed past generations who did wrong. Then He made you successors to see how you would act.

Some ask for a different Qur'an. The Prophet can only follow what is revealed to him. He lived among them a lifetime before it came. They worship things that cannot harm or help them. They call them intercessors with Allah. Mankind was once one community, but then they differed. Only Allah knows the unseen.

hardWords.m: the changing shapes of the moon
people living at the same time in history
ones who speak for someone to get help

82.title: Storms at Sea and the Example of Rain

paragraphs.text: When people taste mercy after hardship, they plot against Allah's verses. At sea, a storm comes and waves surround them. Then they call on Allah sincerely. But when He saves them, they do wrong on the earth. Their wrong only hurts themselves.

Worldly life is like rain that makes plants grow. The earth becomes beautiful, and people think they control it. Then Allah's command comes, and it becomes like a cut harvest. Allah invites to the Home of Peace. Those who do good get the best reward and more. Evildoers will have faces as dark as night.
On that Day, the polytheists and their partners will be separated. The partners will say, "You did not worship us." Every soul will be tested for what it did.
