Ask them: who provides for you and controls hearing and sight? Who brings the living out of the dead? They will say, "Allah." So why not fear Him? Can their partners begin creation or guide to the truth? Most of them follow only guesses. This Qur'an could only come from Allah. It confirms the earlier Scripture.

Some say the Prophet invented the Qur'an. Then let them bring one surah like it, with any helpers besides Allah. They deny what they do not understand. Some believe in it, and some do not. If they deny you, say, "My deeds are mine, and yours are yours." Some listen and look, but the Prophet cannot make the deaf hear or the blind see. Allah never wrongs people. People wrong themselves.

On the Day of gathering, life on earth will seem like one hour. Those who denied meeting Allah will be lost. Every nation has a messenger, and it will be judged with justice. People ask when the promise will come. The Prophet has no power to harm or help himself. Every nation has a fixed term.

If punishment comes at night or by day, why are the criminals in a hurry for it? Will they believe only when it happens? Then they will taste eternal punishment. They ask if it is true. Say, "Yes, by my Lord." A wrongdoer would give the whole earth as ransom. They will hide their regret when they see the punishment.

hardWords.m: a price paid to be set free

84.title: The Allies of Allah Have No Fear

paragraphs.text: Everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to Allah. His promise is true. He gives life and death. The Qur'an is instruction, healing for hearts, guidance, and mercy. So rejoice in Allah's bounty and mercy. It is better than all they gather.

Some make Allah's provision lawful or unlawful by themselves. Did Allah allow this? Allah is full of bounty to people, but most are not grateful. Nothing is hidden from Him, not even an atom's weight on earth or in the heaven. All is in a clear record.

The allies of Allah will have no fear and will not grieve. They believe and fear Allah. They have good news in this life and the next. All honor belongs to Allah. He made the night for rest and the day for seeing. Some say Allah has taken a son. Exalted is He; He needs nothing. Those who invent lies about Allah will not succeed.
Tell them the story of Noah. He said to his people, "I rely on Allah. Make your plan with your partners. Then carry it out against me and give me no delay."

85.title: Noah, Moses, and the Magicians Again

paragraphs.text: Noah asked no payment; his reward was from Allah. His people denied him. Allah saved him and those with him in the ship, and drowned the deniers. Later messengers came with clear proofs, but people still did not believe.

Then Allah sent Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his chiefs. They were arrogant and called the truth magic. They said Moses wanted to turn them from their fathers' ways and gain power in the land. Pharaoh called every skilled magician. Moses told them to throw. Then he said, "This is only magic. Allah will make it worthless." Allah establishes the truth by His words.

Only some youths believed Moses, in fear of Pharaoh. Moses told his people to rely on Allah. They prayed, "Our Lord, save us from the disbelieving people." Allah told Moses and Aaron to settle their people in houses in Egypt. They should make their houses a qiblah and pray. Moses prayed against Pharaoh's wealth, which was leading people astray.

86.title: Pharaoh Drowns, and the People of Jonah

paragraphs.text: Allah answered the prayer of Moses and Aaron. Pharaoh and his soldiers chased the Children of Israel across the sea. As Pharaoh was drowning, he said, "I believe." But it was too late, because he had disobeyed before. Allah saved his body as a sign for later people.

Allah settled the Children of Israel in a good place. They only differed after knowledge came to them. The Prophet is told never to doubt what is revealed. Those against whom Allah's word is fixed will not believe, even with every sign.

Only the people of Jonah believed in time, and their punishment was removed. If Allah willed, everyone on earth would believe. No one can be forced to believe. No soul believes except by Allah's permission. Look at the heavens and the earth. Allah will save His messengers and the believers.
Say, "If you doubt my religion, I do not worship what you worship. I worship Allah, who causes your death." Turn to the true religion and never associate others with Allah.

hardWords.m: made to do something against one's will

paragraphs.text: Do not call on anything besides Allah that cannot help or harm you. If Allah touches you with harm, only He can remove it. If He wants good for you, no one can stop it. Whoever is guided is guided for his own good. Be patient until Allah judges.

A new surah begins. Its verses are perfected and explained by the Wise. Worship only Allah. Ask your Lord for forgiveness and repent. He will give you good provision for a time. If you turn away, fear the punishment of a great Day.

The disbelievers try to hide from Allah. But He knows what they hide and show. Allah gives every creature its provision. He created the heavens and the earth in six days to test who is best in deeds. When told about life after death, disbelievers call it magic.

When Allah takes mercy away from man, he loses hope and is ungrateful. When good returns, he becomes boastful. But the patient who do good will have forgiveness and great reward. Some say the Prophet invented the Qur'an. Then let them bring ten surahs like it.

88.title: Two Groups, and Noah Begins His Call

paragraphs.text: If they cannot answer, know that the Qur'an came with Allah's knowledge. Whoever wants only this world will get it fully here. But in the Hereafter, they will have only the Fire.

One who stands on clear evidence from his Lord is not like others. Before the Qur'an came the Scripture of Moses. Who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah? Witnesses will speak against such people. They blocked Allah's way and will be the greatest losers. Believers who do good and humble themselves will be in Paradise. The two groups are like the blind and deaf, and the seeing and hearing.

Allah sent Noah as a clear warner. He told his people to worship only Allah. The leaders said, "You are only a man like us. Only our lowest people follow you." Noah asked, "Should we force mercy on you when you dislike it?" He asked no wealth for his message. He would not drive away the believers.

89.title: Noah's Ship and the Great Flood

paragraphs.text: Noah said he did not own Allah's treasures or know the unseen. He was not an angel. He would not say the poor believers would get no good. His people said, "You argue too much. Bring the punishment you threaten." Noah said only Allah brings it, if He wills.

Allah told Noah that no more of his people would believe. He told him to build the ship under His watch. The leaders passed by and laughed at him. Noah said they would soon know who would be disgraced.

When Allah's command came, Noah loaded two of each creature, his family, and the few believers. He said, "In the name of Allah is its course." The ship sailed through waves like mountains. Noah called his son to come aboard. His son said a mountain would protect him. But the waves came between them, and he drowned. Then the water went down, and the ship rested on Judiyy.

Noah said, "My Lord, my son is of my family." Allah said, "He is not of your family; his deeds were not righteous." Noah asked Allah's forgiveness. Then he was told to go down from the ship safely, with blessings.
This is news of the unseen that the Prophet did not know before. So be patient; the best end is for the righteous.

Allah sent Hud to 'Aad. He told them to worship Allah alone. He asked for no reward. He told them to ask forgiveness and repent, and Allah would send rain and more strength. They said, "You brought no clear proof. We will not leave our gods." Hud said he was free of their partners. He relied on Allah, who holds every creature by its forelock. Allah saved Hud and the believers. 'Aad rejected His signs and followed every stubborn tyrant. A curse followed them.

Allah sent Salih to Thamud. He said Allah made them from the earth and settled them in it. His Lord is near and answers. They said, "We had hopes in you before. Do you forbid what our fathers worshipped?" Salih showed them the she-camel of Allah as a sign. But they harmed her. So he said, "Enjoy your homes for three days."

hardWords.m: the hair at the front of the head

91.title: Salih Saved, Abraham's Guests, and Lot's People

paragraphs.text: When Allah's command came, He saved Salih and the believers with him. A terrible shriek seized the wrongdoers. They lay dead in their homes, as if they had never lived there. Thamud denied their Lord, so they were sent away.

Messengers came to Abraham with good news. They said, "Peace," and he quickly brought them a roasted calf. When their hands did not reach for it, he felt afraid. They told him not to fear. His wife smiled. She was given good news of Isaac, and after him Jacob. She was amazed, because she and her husband were old. They said this was Allah's decree. Abraham was gentle and often turned to Allah. He pleaded for Lot's people, but Allah's command had come.

When the messengers came to Lot, he was troubled for them. His people rushed to him. Lot asked them to fear Allah and not shame him before his guests. The angels said, "They will never reach you. Leave at night with your family, and let no one look back." Only his wife would be struck. In the morning, Allah turned the city upside down. He rained stones of hard clay upon them.

92.title: Shu'ayb Calls Madyan to Fair Trade

paragraphs.text: The stones were marked by Allah, and His punishment is never far from wrongdoers.

Allah sent Shu'ayb to the people of Madyan. He said, "Worship Allah alone. Do not cheat in measure and weight. Be just, and do not spread corruption on the earth." His people mocked him. They asked if his prayer told them to leave their fathers' gods. Shu'ayb said he only wanted reform, as much as he could. His success came only through Allah. He warned them not to suffer like the people of Noah, Hud, Salih and Lot. He told them to ask forgiveness and repent.

They said, "We think you are weak. Only your family stops us from stoning you." He said, "Do what you will, and I will work too. Soon you will know who is the liar." Then Allah's command came. He saved Shu'ayb and the believers. A shriek seized the wrongdoers, and Madyan was taken away like Thamud.
Allah sent Moses with signs and clear authority to Pharaoh. But his chiefs followed Pharaoh's command, which was not wise. On the Day of Resurrection, Pharaoh will lead his people into the Fire.

hardWords.m: the amount of something you sell
evil and bad acts that spoil things

93.title: The Day of Judgment and a Call to Patience

paragraphs.text: These are stories of the old cities. Some still stand, and some are like a cut harvest. Allah did not wrong them. They wronged themselves. Their false gods could not help them when Allah's command came. Allah's seizure of wrongdoing cities is painful and severe. This is a sign for those who fear the Hereafter. All people will be gathered on that Day, and it is delayed only for a fixed term.

On that Day, no soul will speak without His permission. Some will be wretched, and some will be happy. The wretched will be in the Fire, breathing hard. The happy will be in Paradise, with a gift that never ends.
Do not doubt what the idol worshippers worship. They only copy their fathers. Moses was given the Scripture, but people disagreed about it. Allah will fully repay everyone for their deeds.

So stay on the right path, as you were commanded, and do not go beyond limits. Do not lean toward wrongdoers, or the Fire may touch you. Pray at both ends of the day and in the early night. Good deeds remove bad deeds. Be patient, because Allah never loses the reward of those who do good.

hardWords.m: crops that are cut and gathered

94.title: End of Surah Hud and Joseph's Dream

paragraphs.text: Allah would not destroy cities unjustly while their people did good. If He willed, He could make all people one community. But they keep differing, except those given His mercy. The stories of the messengers make the Prophet's heart firm. They bring truth and a reminder. Say to the disbelievers, "Do your work, and we will do ours. Wait, and we are waiting." The unseen of the heavens and earth belongs to Allah. So worship Him and rely upon Him.
Surah Yusuf begins. These are verses of the clear Book. Allah sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an so that people may understand. It tells the best stories.

Joseph told his father, "I saw eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing to me." His father said, "My son, do not tell your brothers, or they will plot against you. Satan is a clear enemy to man." He said Allah would choose Joseph and teach him to explain events. They said their father loved Joseph and his brother more. They planned to kill Joseph or send him far away. One of them said, "Do not kill him. Throw him into the bottom of a well."

hardWords.m: a group of people living together
to make a secret bad plan

95.title: Joseph in the Well and in Egypt

paragraphs.text: The brothers asked their father to send Joseph with them to play. Jacob feared a wolf would eat him. They promised to guard him. Then they put him into the bottom of the well. Allah told Joseph that one day he would tell them about this. At night, they came to their father weeping. They said a wolf had eaten Joseph. They showed his shirt with false blood. Jacob said, "Your souls have tempted you. Patience is best, and Allah is my helper."

Some travelers came to the well. They pulled up the boy and sold him for a few coins. A man from Egypt bought him. He told his wife to treat Joseph kindly. Allah settled Joseph in the land and gave him wisdom and knowledge.

The woman of the house tried to tempt him. She closed the doors. Joseph said, "I seek refuge in Allah." Allah turned evil away from him. They both ran to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back. Her husband was at the door. A witness from her family said, "Look at the shirt. If it is torn from the back, he is truthful."

hardWords.m: a person who tells what is true

96.title: Joseph Chooses Prison and Explains Dreams

paragraphs.text: Her husband saw the shirt torn from the back. He told Joseph to ignore it, and told his wife to ask forgiveness. Women in the city talked about her. She invited them to a banquet and gave each a knife. When Joseph came out, they admired him and cut their hands. They said, "This is not a man. This is a noble angel!" She said that if he refused her, he would be put in prison. Joseph prayed, "My Lord, prison is dearer to me than what they ask." Allah answered and protected him. Still, he was put in prison.

Two young men entered prison with him. Each told him a dream and asked its meaning. Joseph first called them to Allah. He said, "I follow the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Is Allah, the One, not better than many lords?" Then he explained their dreams. One would serve wine to his master. The other would be crucified. Joseph asked the first to mention him to his master. But Satan made him forget, so Joseph stayed in prison for years.
The king dreamed of seven fat cows and seven thin ones. His chiefs called it confused dreams.

hardWords.m: a big, special meal for guests
looked at with great wonder and liking
killed by being hung on wood

97.title: Joseph's Wisdom and Rise in Egypt

paragraphs.text: The freed prisoner remembered Joseph. Joseph explained the king's dream. People should plant for seven years and store the grain in its spikes. Then seven hard years would come and use up what they saved. After that, a year of rain would come, and people would press fruit again.

The king said, "Bring him to me." But Joseph first asked about the women who cut their hands. The women said, "We know no evil about him." The wife of al-Azeez said, "Now the truth is clear. I tried to tempt him, and he is truthful." She said the soul often pushes toward evil, except when Allah shows mercy.

The king said, "You are now trusted and in a high place." Joseph asked to be put in charge of the storehouses. So Allah gave Joseph power in the land. Allah does not lose the reward of good people, and the Hereafter is even better.

Then Joseph's brothers came for food. He knew them, but they did not know him. He said, "Bring me your brother from your father. If you do not, you will get no more grain." They promised to try to persuade their father.

hardWords.m: made clear and easy to understand
seeds of wheat and similar plants used as food
to make someone agree by talking

98.title: Benjamin Goes to Egypt and the King's Cup

paragraphs.text: Joseph had his servants put the brothers' goods back in their bags. At home, the brothers asked their father to send their brother with them. Jacob said, "Shall I trust you as I trusted you with Joseph before? Allah is the best guardian." Then they found their goods returned. Jacob made them promise by Allah to bring him back. He told his sons to enter the city by different gates. But he said that only Allah decides, and he relied on Him.

Joseph took his brother close and said, "I am your brother. Do not be sad." Then he put the king's measuring bowl in his brother's bag. A caller shouted, "You are thieves!" The brothers said they had not come to cause harm. They agreed that the person with the bowl would be kept as payment. The bowl was found in the brother's bag. This was Allah's plan for Joseph. Above every person of knowledge is one who knows more.
The brothers said, "His brother stole before." Joseph kept his feelings hidden. They begged him to take one of them instead, for their father was old.

hardWords.m: asked again and again, with strong need

paragraphs.text: Joseph refused to take anyone except the one with the bowl. The brothers lost hope and spoke in private. The eldest said, "You promised our father by Allah. I will not leave this land until my father allows me." He told the others to go home and tell the truth.

Jacob said, "Patience is best. Perhaps Allah will bring them all back to me." He turned away and cried, "Oh, my sorrow for Joseph!" His eyes became white from grief. He said, "I complain of my sadness only to Allah." He told them to search for Joseph and his brother. He said only disbelievers lose hope in Allah's mercy.

The brothers returned to Joseph. They said hardship had touched their family, and they asked for charity. Joseph asked, "Do you know what you did to Joseph?" They said, "Are you Joseph?" He said, "Yes, and this is my brother. Allah has been kind to us." They admitted they had sinned. Joseph said, "There is no blame on you today. Allah will forgive you." He sent his shirt to cover his father's face. Far away, Jacob said, "I smell Joseph."

hardWords.m: to say that you are unhappy about something
said that something bad was true

100.title: Joseph's Family Reunited and a Lesson

paragraphs.text: The bringer of good news placed the shirt on Jacob's face, and he could see again. His sons asked him to pray for their forgiveness. He promised to ask his Lord for them. Joseph welcomed his parents into Egypt and raised them on the throne. They all bowed down. Joseph said, "Father, this is the meaning of my old dream." He thanked Allah for taking him out of prison and for bringing his family. He prayed, "Let me die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

This story is news of the unseen. The Prophet was not there when the brothers made their plan. Most people will not believe, even if he tries hard. He asks no payment, and the Qur'an is a reminder for all. People pass by many signs and turn away. Say, "I invite to Allah with clear sight." The messengers before were men from the cities. When they lost hope, Allah's victory came. These stories are a lesson for people of understanding. The Qur'an is not made up. It confirms earlier books and is guidance and mercy.
Surah Ar-Ra'd begins. What is revealed from the Lord is the truth.

hardWords.m: a high seat for a king

101.title: Signs in Creation and Truth Like Water

paragraphs.text: Allah raised the heavens without pillars you can see. He made the sun and moon run for a set time. He spread the earth and placed mountains and rivers in it. He made fruits in pairs. Gardens grow side by side with one water, yet their fruits differ. These are signs for people who think.

The disbelievers ask, "When we are dust, will we live again?" They will have chains on their necks in the Fire. They ask for punishment before good, though Allah is full of forgiveness. Allah knows what every womb carries. He knows the hidden and the seen. Angels guard each person by Allah's command. Allah will not change a people's condition until they change what is in themselves.

Allah shows lightning, and the thunder praises Him. True prayer is to Him alone. Calling others is like stretching hands toward far water that never reaches the mouth. All in the heavens and earth bow to Allah. Is the blind like the seeing? Is darkness like light? Allah is the Creator of all things. Rain fills valleys and carries foam. The foam vanishes, but what helps people remains. This is an example of truth and falsehood.

hardWords.m: tall posts that hold something up
a bright flash of light in a storm

102.title: Hearts Find Rest in Remembering Allah

paragraphs.text: People of understanding keep their promise to Allah. They join what Allah ordered to be joined. They are patient, they pray, and they give in secret and in public. They push away evil with good. They will enter gardens with their righteous parents, spouses and children. Angels will greet them, saying, "Peace be upon you for your patience." But those who break Allah's covenant and spread corruption will have the curse. Allah gives wide provision or limits it. This world is only a short enjoyment.

The disbelievers ask for a sign. Say, "Allah guides to Himself whoever turns to Him." The hearts of believers find rest in the remembrance of Allah. A good end is for those who believe and do good. The Prophet was sent to recite the revelation. Say, "He is my Lord. I rely on Him." Even if a Qur'an moved mountains, all matters still belong to Allah.

Messengers before were mocked too, and Allah seized the mockers. The disbelievers have punishment here and a harder one later. Paradise has rivers below it, with lasting fruit and shade. Say, "I am commanded to worship Allah alone."

hardWords.m: what Allah gives to live, like food and money
laughed at in a hurtful way

103.title: Out of Darkness Into the Light

paragraphs.text: Allah revealed the Qur'an as clear Arabic guidance. Messengers before also had wives and children. No messenger brought a sign without Allah's permission. Allah removes or confirms what He wills, and with Him is the Mother of the Book. The Prophet's duty is only to deliver the message. Allah judges, and no one can change His decision. When the disbelievers say, "You are not a messenger," Allah is enough as Witness.

Surah Ibrahim begins. This Book was revealed to bring people out of darkness into light. Woe to those who prefer this world over the Hereafter. Every messenger spoke the language of his people, so he could explain clearly.

Allah sent Moses to bring his people into the light. Moses reminded them how Allah saved them from Pharaoh's people. Those people killed their sons and caused great pain. Allah declared, "If you are grateful, I will give you more. But if you deny, My punishment is severe." Allah does not need anyone.

The people of Noah, 'Aad and Thamud doubted their messengers. The messengers asked, "Can there be doubt about Allah, Creator of the heavens and earth?" But the people said, "You are only men like us."

hardWords.m: to bring and give to someone

104.title: The Good Word Is Like a Good Tree

paragraphs.text: The messengers said, "We are men like you, but Allah favors whom He wills. Upon Allah we rely, and we will be patient with your harm." The disbelievers threatened to drive them out. Allah told the messengers He would destroy the wrongdoers and settle them in the land. Every stubborn tyrant failed. Hell is before him, with a drink he can hardly swallow.

The deeds of disbelievers are like ashes blown by a strong wind. Allah created the heavens and earth in truth. All will come before Him. The weak will ask the proud leaders for help, but they cannot help. Satan will say, "Allah's promise was true. I promised you and betrayed you. I only called you, and you answered. Do not blame me. Blame yourselves." Believers who did good will enter gardens with rivers. Their greeting there will be "Peace."

A good word is like a good tree. Its root is firm, and its branches reach the sky. It gives fruit at all times. A bad word is like a bad tree, pulled out of the ground. Allah keeps the believers firm in this life and the next.

hardWords.m: refusing to change, even when wrong
a cruel ruler who uses power wrongly
grey powder left after something burns

105.title: Allah's Countless Favors and Abraham's Prayer

paragraphs.text: Some people traded Allah's favor for disbelief. They set up equals to Allah to mislead others. Tell the believers to pray and to spend, in secret and in public. They should do this before a Day with no trade and no friendship.

Allah created the heavens and the earth. He sends rain and brings out fruits for you. He made ships sail and rivers flow for you. He made the sun, moon, night and day work for you. If you tried to count His favors, you could never finish. Yet people are often unjust and ungrateful.

Abraham prayed, "My Lord, make this city safe. Keep me and my sons away from idols." He settled some of his children in a dry valley near the sacred House, so they would pray. He asked Allah to make hearts love them and to give them fruits. He praised Allah for giving him Ishmael and Isaac in old age. He asked for forgiveness for himself, his parents and the believers.
Allah is not unaware of the wrongdoers. He only delays them until a Day when eyes will stare in fear. Then they will ask for more time.

hardWords.m: made someone live in a place
to look hard without moving the eyes

106.title: A New Earth and the Protected Qur'an

paragraphs.text: People lived in the homes of those who wronged themselves before them. They saw what happened to them. The wrongdoers made big plans, but Allah knows all their plans. Allah never breaks His promise to His messengers. One Day, the earth and the heavens will be changed into new ones. All will stand before Allah, the One. The criminals will be chained together. Their clothes will be made of black tar, and fire will cover their faces. Allah will repay every soul for what it earned. This Qur'an is a message to warn people. It teaches them that He is one God.

Surah Al-Hijr begins. These are the verses of a clear Qur'an. One day, the disbelievers will wish they had been Muslims. Let them eat and enjoy false hopes for now. They will soon know. Every city has a fixed time, and no nation can come early or stay late. The disbelievers called the Prophet mad. They asked him to bring angels. But angels come down only with the truth. Allah sent down the Qur'an, and He will surely protect it.

107.title: Stars, Winds, Rain and the Creation of Man

paragraphs.text: Allah sent messengers to the peoples of the past. Every time a messenger came, they laughed at him. Denial enters the hearts of the criminals in the same way. Even if a gate opened in the sky and they climbed through it, they would not believe. They would say, "Our eyes are tricked. We are under magic."

Allah placed great stars in the sky and made it beautiful for those who look. He guarded it from every cursed devil. If a devil tries to steal a hearing, a burning flame chases him. Allah spread out the earth and set firm mountains on it. He made every plant grow in balance. He gave you ways to live, and He feeds creatures you do not feed. The stores of every thing are with Him. He sends it down in a known amount. He sends the winds and the rain to give you drink. He gives life and death. He knows those who came before and those who will come later. He will gather them all.
Allah created man from clay, from dark changed mud.

hardWords.m: the right amount, not too much or too little

108.title: Iblees Refuses to Bow to Adam

paragraphs.text: Allah created the jinn before man, from very hot fire. Then your Lord told the angels, "I will create a human from clay, from dark mud. When I have formed him and breathed life into him, bow down to him." So all the angels bowed down together. Only Iblees refused. He would not join those who bowed.

Allah asked Iblees, "Why did you not bow?" He said, "I will never bow to a human made from clay and mud." Allah said, "Then get out, for you are cast away. The curse is on you until the Day of Judgment." Iblees asked for more time until people are raised again. Allah gave him time until a known Day.

Iblees said, "Because You let me go astray, I will make evil look beautiful to people on earth. I will mislead them all, except Your chosen servants." Allah said, "This is a straight path to Me. You will have no power over My servants. Only those who follow you will go wrong. Hell is the promised place for all of them."

hardWords.m: said that something will surely happen

109.title: Gardens of Peace and Abraham's Guests

paragraphs.text: Hell has seven gates, and each gate has its own group. But the righteous will be in gardens with springs. They will be told, "Enter in peace and safety." Allah will remove any bad feelings from their hearts. They will be like brothers, sitting on thrones and facing each other. They will never feel tired there, and they will never be sent out.
Tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful. And tell them that My punishment is the painful punishment.

Tell them also about the guests of Abraham. They came to him and said, "Peace." Abraham said, "We are afraid of you." They said, "Do not fear. We bring you good news of a wise boy." Abraham was surprised, because he was already old. They said, "Our news is true, so do not lose hope." He answered, "Only those who are lost lose hope in their Lord's mercy." Then he asked about their mission. They said they were sent to a criminal people. But they would save the family of Lot, except his wife. She would stay behind.

hardWords.m: places where water comes up from the ground
an important job someone is sent to do
doing very bad and wrong acts

paragraphs.text: The messengers came to the family of Lot. Lot said, "You are strangers to me." They said, "We have brought what your people used to doubt. We bring the truth, and we are truthful." They told him to leave with his family at night. He should walk behind them, and no one should look back. They should go where they were commanded. Allah told Lot that the sinners would be destroyed by early morning.

The people of the city came, full of joy. Lot said, "These are my guests. Do not shame me. Fear Allah and do not disgrace me." They said, "Did we not forbid you from protecting people?" Lot pointed to his daughters for lawful marriage. But the people were lost in their wild madness, wandering blindly.

So the loud shriek seized them at sunrise. Allah turned their city upside down and rained stones of hard clay on them. In this are signs for people who look carefully. The ruins of those cities are on a road that people still travel. This is a sign for the believers.

hardWords.m: what is left of broken buildings

111.title: End of Surah Al-Hijr: Forgive and Declare

paragraphs.text: The people of the thicket were also wrongdoers, so Allah punished them. Both cities lie on a clear road. The people of Thamud also denied the messengers. Allah gave them His signs, but they turned away. They carved houses out of the mountains and felt safe. But the shriek seized them in the early morning. All that they had earned did not help them at all.
Allah created the heavens, the earth and all between them in truth. The Hour is surely coming. So forgive others in a kind and gentle way. Your Lord is the Creator who knows all.

Allah gave the Prophet the seven often repeated verses and the great Qur'an. Do not look with longing at the pleasures given to some disbelievers. Do not grieve over them. Be gentle and humble with the believers. Say, "I am a clear warner." Some people divided the Qur'an into parts. Allah will question them all about what they did. So declare what you are commanded, and turn away from those who worship others with Allah.

hardWords.m: a place thick with trees and bushes
cut into shape from stone or wood

112.title: Surah An-Nahl Begins: Gifts of Animals and Rain

paragraphs.text: Allah is enough for the Prophet against those who mock him. They set up another god with Allah, but they will soon know. Allah knows their words make his heart tight. So praise your Lord, bow down to Him, and worship Him until death comes.

Surah An-Nahl begins. Allah's command is coming, so do not hurry it. He sends angels with revelation to whom He wills. The message is: "There is no god but Me, so fear Me." He created the heavens and earth in truth. He created man from a small drop, yet man becomes an open opponent.

Allah created grazing animals for you. They give warmth, food and many benefits. They look beautiful going out and coming home. They carry heavy loads to faraway lands. He made horses, mules and donkeys for riding and beauty. Allah shows the right way, though some paths go wrong.

He sends rain from the sky for drinking and for plants. With it He grows crops, olives, palms, grapes and all kinds of fruit. He made the night, day, sun, moon and stars serve you. He spread on the earth things of many colors. These are signs for those who think.

hardWords.m: someone who argues or fights against you

113.title: Countless Favors and the Arrogant Deniers

paragraphs.text: Allah made the sea serve you. You eat fresh meat from it and take out ornaments to wear. Ships sail through it while you seek His bounty. He set firm mountains so the earth would not shake. He made rivers, roads and landmarks, and people find their way by the stars. Is the One who creates like one who cannot create? If you count Allah's favors, you could never finish. The idols people call on create nothing. They are dead, not alive.

Your god is one God. Those who deny the Hereafter have proud hearts. When asked what Allah sent down, they say, "Old stories of past peoples." They will carry their own sins and some sins of those they misled. People before them also plotted. But Allah shook their building from its base, and the roof fell on them. On Judgment Day, Allah will shame them. The proud will enter the gates of Hell.
Those who fear Allah will say their Lord sent down good. The home of the Hereafter is better for them.

hardWords.m: nice things worn for beauty, like jewelry
signs on the land that help you find the way
thinking you are better than others
the bottom part that holds something up

114.title: Be, and It Is: Allah's Promise

paragraphs.text: The righteous will enter gardens with rivers below, and they will have all they wish. When angels take the souls of good and pure people, they say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise." The disbelievers wait only for the angels or Allah's command. Allah did not wrong them; they wronged themselves.

Those who worship others say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have done this." But the duty of messengers is only to deliver the message. Allah sent a messenger to every nation, saying, "Worship Allah and keep away from false gods." Some were guided, and some went astray. Travel the earth and see the end of the deniers. They swear that Allah will not raise the dead. But it is His true promise. When He wants a thing, He only says, "Be," and it is.

Those who left their homes for Allah after being wronged will get a good place in this world. Their reward in the Hereafter is greater. They were patient and relied on their Lord. Messengers before were men who received revelation. Can evil planners feel safe from punishment? Allah could seize them at any time. Yet your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

hardWords.m: to take hold of suddenly and strongly

115.title: All Creation Bows, and Every Favor Is Allah's

paragraphs.text: Look at the things Allah created. Their shadows turn right and left, bowing humbly to Allah. All creatures in the heavens and earth bow to Him, and so do the angels. They are not proud. They fear their Lord and do what they are told. Allah says, "Do not take two gods. He is only one God, so fear Me." All in the heavens and earth belong to Him.

Every blessing you have comes from Allah. When hardship touches you, you cry to Him for help. But when He removes it, some of you set up partners with Him. Some people claim daughters for Allah, while they want sons for themselves. When one of them hears of a baby girl, his face becomes dark with sadness. He hides from people and wonders whether to keep her or bury her. Evil is their judgment. If Allah punished people at once for their wrongs, no creature would be left. But He gives them time until a set term.
Satan made bad deeds look good to nations before. Allah sent the Book to explain what people disagree about. It is guidance and mercy.

hardWords.m: dark shapes made when something blocks light
others put next to Allah in worship
a decision about what is right

116.title: Signs in Milk, Honey and Birds

paragraphs.text: Allah sends rain and brings dead land back to life. From the bellies of cattle He gives you pure milk that is pleasant to drink. From palm trees and grapes you make drinks and good food. Your Lord inspired the bee to make homes in mountains, trees and buildings. It eats from all fruits. From its belly comes a drink of many colors. In it there is healing for people.

Allah creates you and then takes you in death. Some live to a very weak old age and forget what they knew. Allah gave some people more provision than others. He gave you spouses, children and grandchildren. Yet some people worship things that cannot provide anything. Allah gives examples. Is a helpless slave equal to a free man who spends in secret and in public? Is a man who can do nothing equal to one who orders justice?

The coming of the Hour is like a blink of the eye. Allah brought you out of your mothers knowing nothing. He gave you hearing, sight and minds. Only Allah holds up the birds in the sky. He gave you homes, tents of animal skin, and clothes for heat and battle.

hardWords.m: a quick closing and opening of the eye

paragraphs.text: If people turn away, the Prophet's duty is only to deliver the message clearly. They know Allah's favor, yet they deny it. On the Day of Judgment, Allah will bring a witness from every nation. The wrongdoers will not be allowed to make excuses. Their false gods will call them liars. The Prophet will be a witness over his nation. The Book explains all things. It is guidance, mercy and good news for Muslims.
Allah orders justice, good conduct and giving to relatives. He forbids shameful deeds, evil and oppression.

Keep your promises to Allah, and do not break your oaths. Do not be like a woman who undid her strong thread after spinning it. Do not use oaths to trick each other because one group is richer. What you have will end, but what Allah has will last. Whoever does good, man or woman, and believes will live a good life. Before reading the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan.

hardWords.m: serious promises made by Allah's name

118.title: Satan's Limits and Lawful Good Food

paragraphs.text: Satan has no power over believers who rely on their Lord. His power is only over those who take him as a friend. When Allah replaces one verse with another, the disbelievers call the Prophet a liar. But the Pure Spirit brought it down in truth from the Lord. They claim a man teaches him. Yet that man's language is foreign, and the Qur'an is in clear Arabic. Those who deny Allah's verses are the real liars.

Some people disbelieve after believing. A person forced to speak against his faith, with a heart still firm, is excused. But those who choose disbelief face Allah's anger. They loved this world more than the Hereafter. Allah is Forgiving to those who left their homes and stayed patient. Every soul will speak for itself on that Day and be fully repaid.

Allah gives the example of a safe city with plenty of food. Its people denied Allah's favors, so they tasted hunger and fear. So eat what is lawful and good, and be thankful. Allah has forbidden dead animals, blood, pork, and what is offered to other than Allah. But He is Forgiving to one forced by need.

hardWords.m: puts one thing in place of another

119.title: Abraham's Example and the Night Journey

paragraphs.text: Do not make up lies about Allah by calling things lawful or unlawful. Those who do this will not succeed. Their joy is short, and their punishment is painful. Allah is Forgiving to those who do wrong in ignorance, then repent and correct themselves.

Abraham was a leader who obeyed Allah and turned to the truth. He never set up partners with Allah. He was thankful, and Allah chose and guided him. He has good in this world and will be among the righteous. The Prophet was told to follow the faith of Abraham.

Call people to your Lord's way with wisdom and kind advice. Argue with them in the best way. If you punish, do it only as much as you were harmed. But patience is better. Do not grieve or worry about their plots. Allah is with those who fear Him and do good.

Surah Al-Isra begins. Glory be to Allah, who took His Servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa. Allah blessed the land around it, to show him His signs. Allah gave Moses the Scripture as guidance for the Children of Israel. He told them they would spread corruption on earth twice.

hardWords.m: words that help someone choose well

120.title: The Qur'an Guides and Each Soul's Record

paragraphs.text: When the first warning came true, Allah sent strong servants against the Children of Israel. Later, Allah gave them victory again and helped them with wealth and children. If you do good, it is for yourselves. If you do evil, it is against yourselves. When the second warning came, enemies entered the temple and destroyed what they took. Allah may still have mercy, but if they return to sin, He will return to punishment.

This Qur'an guides to the straightest way. It gives good news to believers who do good. Man often prays for evil as he prays for good, because he is hasty. Allah made the night and day two signs. The day is bright so people can seek His bounty and count the years.

Every person's deeds are tied to his neck. On Judgment Day, he will be shown an open record and told, "Read your record." No one carries another person's burden. Allah never punishes until He sends a messenger.
Whoever wants only this world may get some of it, but then Hell. Whoever wants the Hereafter and works for it as a believer will be rewarded. The Hereafter has much greater ranks.

hardWords.m: in too much of a hurry

121.title: Kindness to Parents and a Good Way of Life

paragraphs.text: Do not make any other deity equal with Allah, or you will be blamed and left alone. Your Lord has ordered that you worship only Him and treat parents well. When they grow old with you, do not say even "uff" to them or push them away. Speak to them with honor, and be gentle with them out of mercy. Pray, "My Lord, have mercy on them, as they raised me when I was small." Allah knows what is inside you. He forgives those who keep turning back to Him.

Give relatives, the poor and the traveler their right, but do not waste. Wasteful people are brothers of the devils. If you must turn away from a needy person for now, speak to him kindly. Do not hold your hand tight like a chain, and do not open it fully either. Allah gives more provision to some and less to others.

Do not kill your children for fear of being poor; Allah provides for them and for you. Do not go near unlawful sexual relations, because it is an evil path. Do not take a life Allah has made sacred, except by right. Do not touch an orphan's property, except in the best way. Keep every promise, and give full measure with a fair scale.
Do not follow what you do not know, because your hearing, sight and heart will be questioned. Do not walk on the earth with pride. Your Lord hates the evil in all these things.

hardWords.m: spending money in a bad or useless way
holy, given special respect by Allah
thinking you are better than others

122.title: All Creation Praises Allah; People Will Rise Again

paragraphs.text: These teachings are part of the wisdom Allah revealed. Do not make another deity equal with Allah, or you will be thrown into Hell. Some claimed that Allah took daughters from the angels. This is a terrible saying. The Qur'an explains things in many ways, yet the disbelievers only run further away. If there were other gods with Him, they would have looked for a way to the Owner of the Throne. The seven heavens, the earth and everything in them glorify Him, but people do not understand how. He is patient and forgiving.

When the Prophet recites the Qur'an, Allah puts a hidden barrier between him and those who deny the Hereafter. Their hearts are covered and their ears are deaf. Allah knows what they whisper in private. The wrongdoers say he is a man affected by magic. They have gone astray and cannot find a way.

They ask, "When we are bones and dust, will we be raised again?" Say that even if they were stones or iron, they would be raised. The One who made them the first time will bring them back. When they ask when, say it may be soon. On that Day, they will feel they stayed only a little while.

Allah's servants should say what is best, because Satan causes trouble between them. He is a clear enemy to people. Allah may show mercy or punish as He wills. He made some prophets exceed others, and He gave David the Psalms.

hardWords.m: the great royal seat of a king

123.title: Iblees' Threat and Allah's Honor for Mankind

paragraphs.text: Those they call on as gods cannot remove any trouble from them. Those ones themselves look for a way to their Lord, hoping for His mercy and fearing His punishment. Every city will be destroyed or punished before the Day of Resurrection. Allah held back signs only because earlier peoples denied them. Thamud were given the she-camel as a clear sign, but they wronged her. The vision shown to the Prophet and the cursed tree in the Qur'an are a trial for people.

The angels bowed to Adam, except Iblees. He said, "Should I bow to one You made from clay?" He asked for time until the Day of Resurrection and promised to destroy Adam's descendants, except a few. Allah said Hell would be the reward for him and his followers. His promises are only deception. He has no power over Allah's true servants.

Allah drives ships across the sea for you. When danger comes at sea, people call only on Him. But once they are safe on land, they turn away. Do they feel safe that the land will not swallow them, or that He will not drown them in the sea again?

Allah has honored the children of Adam and given them good things. On a coming Day, every people will be called with their record. Those given it in the right hand will read it, and they will not be wronged at all. Whoever is blind in this life will be blind in the Hereafter.

hardWords.m: children, grandchildren and all who come after
a trick that makes you believe something false
something shown, like a dream or sight
take in through the mouth; here, the land takes them in

124.title: Prayer Times, Truth, and the Matchless Qur'an

paragraphs.text: The disbelievers almost turned the Prophet away from what was revealed, so that he would invent something else about Allah. Allah made him strong, or he might have leaned toward them a little. Then he would have tasted double punishment in life and in death. They also nearly drove him out of the land, but they would not stay long after him. This is Allah's way with His messengers, and it never changes.

Establish prayer from when the sun goes down from its height until the dark of night, and also the recitation at dawn. Pray in part of the night as extra worship. Perhaps your Lord will raise you to a praised station. Say, "Truth has come and falsehood has gone. Falsehood always disappears." The Qur'an brings healing and mercy to believers, but only loss to the wrongdoers.

When Allah gives a person a favor, he turns away. When evil touches him, he loses hope. People ask about the soul. Say the soul is a matter of Allah, and people have only a little knowledge. If Allah willed, He could take away what He revealed, but He keeps it as a mercy.

If all humans and jinn worked together, they could not produce anything like this Qur'an. Still, most people refuse everything except disbelief. They say they will not believe until the Prophet makes a spring burst from the ground.

hardWords.m: make up something that is not true

125.title: Strange Demands and the Signs Given to Moses

paragraphs.text: They also demand a garden with rivers, a house of gold, or for the sky to fall on them in pieces. They want him to climb into the sky and bring down a book they can read. He answers, "Exalted is my Lord! I am only a human messenger." People refused to believe because Allah sent a human. If angels lived on the earth, Allah would send them an angel messenger. Allah is enough as a Witness.

Whoever Allah guides is truly guided. Those He leaves astray will be gathered on their faces on the Day of Resurrection, blind, unable to speak and deaf. Hell will be their home, because they denied the verses and doubted they would be raised from bones. But Allah, who made the heavens and earth, can create them again. If people owned the treasures of Allah's mercy, they would hold them back. Man is stingy.

Allah gave Moses nine clear signs. Pharaoh said Moses was affected by magic. Moses replied that only the Lord of the heavens and earth sent these signs. Pharaoh wanted to drive them out of the land, but Allah drowned him and those with him. The Children of Israel were told to live in the land.
The Qur'an came down with the truth, sent in parts so it could be recited slowly over a long time. Those given knowledge before it fall down in prostration when they hear it.

hardWords.m: ask strongly, as if it is your right
not wanting to give or spend
putting the forehead on the ground in worship

126.title: Allah's Best Names and the Youths of the Cave

paragraphs.text: Those people say, "Exalted is our Lord! His promise has come true." They fall on their faces weeping, and the Qur'an makes them more humble. Call on Allah or call on the Most Merciful. All the best names belong to Him. In prayer, do not recite too loudly or too quietly, but choose a middle way. Praise Allah, who has no son and no partner in His kingdom. He needs no protector because of weakness.

All praise is for Allah, who sent the Book to His Servant without any crookedness. It warns of a severe punishment and gives good news to believers who do good deeds. They will have a good reward forever. It also warns those who say Allah has taken a son. They have no knowledge of this, and neither did their fathers. The Prophet might almost harm himself with sadness if they do not believe. Allah made the beauty of the earth a test to see who does best. Later, He will turn it into dry, empty ground.

Allah asks if people think the companions of the cave were a wonder among His signs. Some young men went to a cave and prayed for mercy and right guidance. Allah covered their ears with sleep there for many years. Then He woke them, to show which group counted their time best. They were youths who believed in their Lord, and He increased their guidance.

hardWords.m: the land and power a king rules

127.title: The Cave Story and Saying 'If Allah Wills'

paragraphs.text: Allah made the hearts of the youths firm. They said their Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth, and they would never call on any other deity. No one is more unjust than one who lies about Allah. So they left their people and went to the cave, hoping for Allah's mercy.

The sun turned away from their cave when it rose and when it set. A person would think them awake, but they were asleep. Allah turned them right and left, while their dog stretched its legs at the entrance. When Allah woke them, they thought they had stayed a day or part of a day. They sent one of them to the city with a silver coin to buy food. He had to be careful, because people might stone them.

Allah let people find them, so they would know His promise is true. People argued about them and decided to build a masjid over them. Some guessed their number, but only Allah and a few know. Never say you will do something tomorrow without adding, "If Allah wills." They stayed in the cave three hundred and nine years.

Recite the Book of your Lord; no one can change His words. Stay patient with those who call on their Lord morning and evening. Do not obey one whose heart is careless and who follows his desire. A fire waits for the wrongdoers, but the reward of those who do good will never be lost.

hardWords.m: the place where you go in

128.title: The Two Gardens and the Passing World

paragraphs.text: The believers will have gardens of lasting home with rivers flowing beneath. They will wear gold bracelets and green clothes of fine silk, resting on decorated couches. What an excellent reward!

Allah gives an example of two men. One had two gardens of grapes, with palm trees around them, crops between them and a river flowing through. He said proudly to his friend, "I have more wealth and more men than you." He entered his garden, wronging himself, and said, "I do not think this will ever end, or that the Hour will come. Even if I return to my Lord, I will find something better."

His friend replied, "Do you disbelieve in the One who created you from dust? As for me, Allah is my Lord, and I join no one with Him. When you entered your garden, why did you not say, 'What Allah willed; there is no power except in Allah'? My Lord may give me better and send a disaster on your garden." Then all his fruit was ruined. He wrung his hands over what he had spent and said, "I wish I had not joined anyone with my Lord." True authority belongs to Allah.

This life is like rain that makes plants grow; then they dry up, and the wind scatters them. Wealth and children are only decoration of this life, but lasting good deeds are better with your Lord. On a coming Day, the mountains will be moved and all people gathered.

129.title: The Open Record and Moses Begins a Journey

paragraphs.text: People will stand before your Lord in rows, just as He created them the first time. The record of deeds will be opened. The criminals will fear it and cry, "What book is this that leaves out nothing, small or great?" Allah wrongs no one. Iblees refused to bow to Adam. He was of the jinn and disobeyed his Lord. So why take him and his children as allies, when they are your enemies? On that Day, the false partners will not answer those who call them, and the criminals will see the Fire with no escape.

The Qur'an gives every kind of example, but man argues more than anything. Messengers come only to give good news and warnings. Disbelievers argue with falsehood and make fun of the verses. No one is more unjust than one who is reminded and turns away. Allah is Forgiving and full of mercy. He does not hurry their punishment, but they have a fixed time they cannot escape, like the cities destroyed before.

Moses told his servant he would keep traveling until he reached the meeting place of the two seas. There they forgot their fish, and it slipped into the sea. Later Moses asked for their meal, because they were tired. The boy said he forgot the fish at the rock, and Satan made him forget. Moses said, "That is what we were looking for," and they went back.

130.title: Moses Learns Patience from Allah's Servant

paragraphs.text: They found one of Allah's servants, who had received mercy and special knowledge from Allah. Moses asked to follow him and learn from his knowledge. The man said, "You will not be able to be patient with me. How can you be patient with what you do not fully know?" Moses promised to be patient and obey, if Allah willed. The man said, "Then do not ask me about anything until I tell you."

They got on a ship, and al-Khidhr made a hole in it. Moses said, "Did you do this to drown its people? This is a serious thing!" Al-Khidhr reminded him that he could not be patient. Moses asked him not to blame him for forgetting. Then they met a boy, and al-Khidhr killed him. Moses cried, "You killed an innocent soul! This is terrible." Again al-Khidhr reminded him. Moses said, "If I ask again, do not keep me with you."

In a town, the people refused to give them food. Al-Khidhr repaired a wall there that was about to fall. Moses said he could have asked for payment. Al-Khidhr said, "Now we must part, but I will explain." The ship belonged to poor workers, and a king was taking every good ship by force, so he damaged it. The boy's parents were believers, and he feared the boy would burden them with disbelief. So they hoped their Lord would give them a better, purer child.

hardWords.m: give a heavy load or trouble

131.title: The Hidden Treasure and Dhul-Qarnayn's Journeys

paragraphs.text: The wall belonged to two orphan boys in the city. Beneath it was their treasure, and their father had been a righteous man. Allah wanted them to grow up and take out their treasure, as a mercy. Al-Khidhr said he did not do these things by his own choice.

People asked the Prophet about Dhul-Qarnayn. Allah gave him power on earth and a way to reach everything. He traveled until he reached the place where the sun sets. It seemed to set in a spring of dark mud, and he found a people there. Allah let him choose to punish them or treat them well. He said wrongdoers would be punished, and then Allah would punish them more. But believers who do good would have Paradise and easy words. Then he traveled to where the sun rises. He found a people with no shelter from it.

Next, he reached a place between two mountains. The people there could hardly understand speech. They said Gog and Magog were causing corruption, and offered to pay him for a barrier. He said what Allah gave him was better, but asked for their help. He placed sheets of iron between the mountains, heated them like fire, and poured melted copper over them. Gog and Magog could not climb it or dig through. He said, "This is a mercy from my Lord. When His promise comes, He will make it flat."

132.title: The Greatest Losers and Zechariah's Prayer

paragraphs.text: On that Day, people will surge into each other like waves. The Horn will be blown, and all will be gathered. Hell will be shown openly to the disbelievers, whose eyes were covered from remembering Allah. The greatest losers are those whose work in this life is lost, while they think they are doing well. They disbelieved in their Lord's verses and in meeting Him. So their deeds are worthless, and on the Day of Resurrection they will have no weight. Hell is their reward, because they made fun of His signs and messengers.

Those who believe and do good deeds will have the Gardens of Paradise as their home. They will stay there forever and never wish to leave. If the sea were ink for writing the words of Allah, the sea would run out before His words end. The Prophet is only a man, but it was revealed to him that only one deity is to be worshipped. Whoever hopes to meet his Lord should do good work and worship no one else with Him.

The next surah begins with the letters Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad. It mentions Allah's mercy to His servant Zechariah, who prayed to his Lord quietly. He said his bones were weak and his hair had turned white. He feared for those who would come after him, and his wife could not have children. So he asked Allah for an heir.

hardWords.m: one who receives what a person leaves after death

133.title: The Birth of John and the News to Mary

paragraphs.text: Zechariah asked for a son who would inherit from him and from the family of Jacob, and who would please Allah. He was given good news of a boy named John, a name given to no one before. He asked how this could be, since his wife was barren and he was very old. The answer came that it is easy for Allah, who created him when he was nothing. As a sign, he would not speak to people for three nights, though he was healthy. He came out of his prayer room and signaled to his people to praise Allah morning and afternoon.

John was told to hold the Scripture firmly. Allah gave him wisdom while still a boy, along with kindness and purity. He feared Allah and was good to his parents, not proud or disobedient. Peace was on him the day he was born, the day he dies, and the day he is raised alive.

Mary went away from her family to a place in the east and put a screen between them. Allah sent His Angel to her in the form of a man. She said, "I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you." He said he was a messenger from her Lord, bringing news of a pure boy. She asked how, since no man had touched her. He said it is easy for Allah, and the boy would be a sign and a mercy. So she became pregnant and went to a far place.

hardWords.m: showed a message with the hands
carrying a baby inside the body

paragraphs.text: The pain of childbirth brought Mary to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "I wish I had died before this and been forgotten." Then a voice called from below her, "Do not be sad. Your Lord has put a stream beneath you. Shake the palm tree, and fresh dates will fall. Eat, drink and be happy. If you see anyone, say you have promised the Most Merciful not to speak today."

She brought the baby to her people. They said, "O Mary, you have done something shocking! Your father and mother were not bad people." She pointed to the baby. They asked how they could speak to a child in the cradle. Jesus said, "I am the servant of Allah. He gave me the Scripture and made me a prophet. He blessed me wherever I am and ordered me to pray and give zakah. He made me good to my mother, not proud. Peace is on me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I am raised alive."

That is Jesus, son of Mary, the truth about which people argue. It does not suit Allah to take a son. When He decides something, He only says "Be," and it is. Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. Groups differed about Jesus, and the disbelievers will face a terrible Day. Warn them of the Day of Regret, while they are careless.

hardWords.m: the act of giving birth to a baby
the thick main part of a tree
very surprising in a bad way
a small bed for a baby

135.title: Abraham's Gentle Words to His Father

paragraphs.text: Allah will inherit the earth and everyone on it, and all will return to Him.

Abraham was a truthful man and a prophet. He asked his father, "Why do you worship what cannot hear, see or help you?" He said knowledge had come to him, so his father should follow him to a straight path. He warned him not to worship Satan, who disobeyed the Most Merciful. He feared a punishment would touch his father. His father said, "Do you turn away from my gods? If you do not stop, I will stone you. Stay away from me." Abraham answered, "Peace be on you. I will ask my Lord to forgive you, for He is kind to me." He said he would leave them and pray only to his Lord.
When he left them, Allah gave him Isaac and Jacob and made each of them a prophet. He gave them His mercy and a high, honored name.

Moses was chosen, a messenger and a prophet. Allah called him from the right side of the mountain and brought him near. He made his brother Aaron a prophet too. Ishmael kept his promises. He told his people to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was pleased with him. Idrees was also a truthful man and a prophet.

hardWords.m: stop blaming someone for a wrong

136.title: Paradise for the Repentant, Hell for the Proud

paragraphs.text: Allah raised Idrees to a high place. These were prophets Allah favored, from the descendants of Adam, of those carried with Noah, and of Abraham and Israel. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping. But later generations neglected prayer and followed their desires, so they will meet evil. Those who repent, believe and do good will enter Paradise and will not be wronged. Its lasting gardens are promised by the Most Merciful in the unseen. There they will hear no bad talk, only peace, and they will have provision morning and afternoon.

The angels come down only by your Lord's order. Everything before them, behind them and between belongs to Him, and He never forgets. He is Lord of the heavens and earth, so worship Him patiently. Is there anyone like Him? The disbeliever asks if he will be brought back after death. Does man not remember that Allah created him when he was nothing?

Allah will gather them with the devils on their knees around Hell. Everyone will come to it, but Allah will save those who feared Him, and the wrongdoers will stay there. When the verses are recited, the disbelievers ask the believers which group has a better position. Yet Allah destroyed many earlier generations who had more wealth and better looks.

hardWords.m: people born and living at about the same time
the middle joints of the legs

137.title: False Hopes and a Terrible Claim

paragraphs.text: The Most Merciful gives more time to those in error. When they see what was promised, punishment or the Hour, they will learn who is worse in position and weaker. Allah adds guidance to the guided, and lasting good deeds are best with your Lord.

Look at the one who denied the verses and said he would surely be given wealth and children. Has he seen the unseen, or did he get a promise from the Most Merciful? No! His words will be written down, and his punishment will be increased. He will come to Allah alone, leaving behind what he spoke of. People took other deities for honor, but those deities will deny their worship and turn against them.

Devils are sent to push the disbelievers toward evil. So do not be impatient about them; their days are counted. On a coming Day, the righteous will be gathered to the Most Merciful as honored guests, and the criminals will be driven to Hell, thirsty. No one can speak for others, except one who took a promise from the Most Merciful.
They say the Most Merciful has taken a son. This is a horrible thing to say! The heavens almost tear apart, the earth splits, and the mountains fall down because of this claim.

hardWords.m: people who are invited and welcomed
something a person says is true

138.title: All Come as Servants; Moses Sees a Fire

paragraphs.text: It does not suit the Most Merciful to take a son. Everyone in the heavens and earth will come to Him as a servant. He has counted them all exactly, and each will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection.

The Most Merciful will give love to those who believe and do good deeds. The Qur'an was made easy in Arabic, so the Prophet can give good news to the righteous and warn stubborn people. Allah destroyed many generations before them. Can you see any of them now, or hear any sound from them?

The next surah begins with the letters Ta, Ha. The Qur'an was not sent down to make the Prophet suffer. It is a reminder for those who fear Allah. It comes from the One who created the earth and the high heavens. The Most Merciful is established above the Throne. Everything in the heavens, on the earth, between them and under the soil is His. If you speak aloud, He still knows the secret and what is even more hidden. There is no deity except Him, and the best names belong to Him.
Has the story of Moses reached you? Once he saw a fire. He told his family to wait, hoping to bring them a burning stick or to find some guidance at the fire.

hardWords.m: the earth in which plants grow

139.title: Allah Speaks to Moses in the Sacred Valley

paragraphs.text: When Moses came near the fire, a voice called him: "O Moses, I am your Lord. Take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa. I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed. I am Allah; there is no deity except Me. Worship Me and pray to remember Me. The Hour is surely coming. I almost hide it, so every soul is paid back for its efforts. Do not let one who denies it and follows his desire turn you away, or you would be ruined."

Allah asked what was in his right hand. Moses said it was his staff. He leaned on it, knocked down leaves for his sheep, and used it in other ways. Allah told him to throw it down. It became a snake, moving fast. Allah said, "Take it and do not fear. We will return it as it was." Then He told Moses to hold his hand to his side; it would come out white, with no illness. These were some of His greater signs.
Allah sent Moses to Pharaoh, who had gone beyond all limits. Moses prayed, "My Lord, open my chest for me, make my task easy, and untie the knot from my tongue."

hardWords.m: a job that must be done
a tight tie in a rope or string

paragraphs.text: Moses asked Allah to make people understand his speech. He asked for a helper from his own family, his brother Aaron, to add to his strength and share his task. Then together they could praise Allah and remember Him often, for Allah always sees them. Allah said, "Your request is granted, O Moses."

Allah reminded Moses of an earlier favor. He inspired his mother to put him in a chest and place it in the river. The river carried it to the bank, where an enemy of Allah and of Moses took him. Allah gave him love and raised him under His eye. His sister came and offered to show them someone to look after the baby. So Allah returned him to his mother, to comfort her and end her sadness. Later Moses killed a man, but Allah saved him and tested him with a hard trial. He lived for years among the people of Madyan, then came at the time Allah had decided. Allah chose him for Himself.

Allah told Moses and his brother to go with His signs and never grow weak in remembering Him. They were to go to Pharaoh, who had gone beyond limits, and speak to him gently, so that he might remember or fear Allah.

hardWords.m: put an idea into someone's heart
make someone feel calm and happy

paragraphs.text: Moses and Aaron feared Pharaoh might hurry to hurt them or go too far. Allah said, "Do not fear. I am with you both; I hear and I see." They were to tell him they were messengers from his Lord, and ask him to send the Children of Israel with them and stop hurting them. Peace is for those who follow guidance, and punishment is for those who deny and turn away.

Pharaoh asked, "Who is your Lord?" Moses said, "Our Lord gave each thing its form and then guided it." Pharaoh asked about past generations. Moses said their knowledge is with his Lord in a record; He never errs or forgets. He made the earth like a bed, with roads, and sent rain to grow many kinds of plants. People eat, and their animals graze. From the earth Allah created us, into it He returns us, and from it He will bring us out again.

Pharaoh saw all the signs but denied them. He accused Moses of using magic to drive them out of their land, and promised to bring magic like it. Moses set the meeting for the festival day, when people gather in the morning. Pharaoh made his plan and came. Moses warned the magicians not to invent lies about Allah, or He would destroy them with punishment.

142.title: The Magicians Believe and the Sea Covers Pharaoh

paragraphs.text: The magicians argued secretly among themselves. They said Moses and Aaron wanted to drive them out and end their best way of life. So they made their plan and stood in a line. Moses let them throw first. Their ropes and sticks seemed to move by their magic, and Moses felt fear inside. Allah said, "Do not fear; you will be on top. Throw what is in your right hand. It will swallow what they made. A magician's trick never succeeds."

The magicians fell down in prostration and said, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." Pharaoh was angry that they believed without his permission. He threatened to cut off their hands and feet and crucify them on palm trunks. They answered, "We will never prefer you over the clear proofs and our Creator. You can only rule over this worldly life. We believe, so that our Lord will forgive our sins."

Whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal will have Hell, where he neither dies nor lives. Believers who do good will have the highest ranks in lasting gardens with rivers. Allah told Moses to travel by night with His servants and strike a dry path through the sea. Pharaoh chased them with his soldiers, and the sea covered them.

hardWords.m: kill by fixing to a wooden post

143.title: The Golden Calf and the Samiri

paragraphs.text: Pharaoh misled his people. Allah saved the Children of Israel from their enemy and sent them manna and quails. He told them to eat the good things and not go beyond limits, or His anger would fall on them. But Allah keeps forgiving whoever repents, believes, does good and stays guided.

Moses hurried ahead of his people to meet Allah, hoping to please Him. Allah told him that his people had been tested, and the Samiri had led them astray. Moses went back angry and sad. He asked if the promise had seemed too long, or if they wanted Allah's anger, since they broke their promise to him. They said they did not break it by choice. They had carried heavy jewelry of the people and threw it into the fire, as the Samiri did.

The Samiri made them a calf statue that made a sound. They claimed it was the deity of Moses too, and that he had forgotten. Could they not see it could not answer them or bring harm or benefit? Aaron had warned them it was a test and told them to follow him. But they said they would keep worshipping it until Moses returned.

Moses asked Aaron why he did not stop them. Aaron said, "O son of my mother, do not hold my beard or my head. I feared you would say I divided the Children of Israel." Then Moses asked the Samiri what he had done.

hardWords.m: rings, chains and other gold things worn for beauty
a shape of a person or animal made of metal or stone
hair on a man's chin and face

144.title: The End of the Calf and the Silent Day

paragraphs.text: The Samiri said he saw what others did not. He took a handful of dust from the track of the messenger and threw it, because his soul tempted him. Moses told him to go away. All his life he would say, "No touching," and he had a meeting in the Hereafter he could not miss. Moses said they would burn the calf and scatter it in the sea. Your only deity is Allah, who knows all things.

Allah tells the Prophet news of the past and has given him the Qur'an. Whoever turns away from it will carry a heavy load on the Day of Resurrection. When the Horn is blown, the criminals will be gathered blue-eyed. They will whisper that they stayed only ten days in the world. The best of them will say only one day.

People ask about the mountains. Allah will blow them away and leave the earth a flat plain, with no low or high places. Everyone will follow the Caller, and all voices will be quiet before the Most Merciful. No one can speak for others except with His permission. Allah knows what is before and after them. All faces will be humble before the Ever-Living. Whoever carries wrongdoing will fail, but a believer who does good will not fear injustice.

hardWords.m: as much as a hand can hold
made someone want to do wrong

145.title: Adam, the Tree, and Turning from Remembrance

paragraphs.text: The Qur'an was sent in Arabic, with many warnings, so people may avoid sin and remember. Allah is the true King, high above all. The Prophet should not hurry with the Qur'an before its revelation is complete, but pray, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

Allah took a promise from Adam before, but he forgot and was not firm. When the angels bowed to Adam, Iblees refused. Allah warned Adam that Iblees was an enemy to him and his wife, and must not get them out of Paradise. There they would never be hungry, naked, thirsty or hot. But Satan whispered to him, offering a tree of eternal life and a kingdom that never ends. Adam and his wife ate from it, and their bodies became uncovered, so they covered themselves with leaves. Adam disobeyed and made a mistake. Then his Lord chose him, forgave him and guided him.

Allah sent them down from Paradise. Whoever follows His guidance will not go astray or suffer. But whoever turns away from His remembrance will have a hard life and will be raised blind. He will ask why, and Allah will say that he forgot His signs, so he is forgotten today. Many generations were destroyed before, and people walk among their homes. Without Allah's earlier word and a fixed term, punishment would come at once.

146.title: Patience, Prayer, and People Who Ignore Warnings

paragraphs.text: Be patient with what they say, and praise your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and in parts of the night and the day, so you may be content. Do not look with desire at the worldly beauty given to some of them as a test. Your Lord's provision is better and lasts longer. Tell your family to pray, and be steady in it. Allah does not ask you for provision; He provides for you. They ask for a sign, but proof came in the earlier scriptures. If they had been destroyed before a messenger came, they would have complained. Say, "Everyone is waiting, so wait."

The time of people's account is near, but they carelessly turn away. When a new reminder comes, they listen while playing, with distracted hearts. The wrongdoers whisper, "Is he not just a human like you?" They call the revelation mixed-up dreams, something invented, or poetry, and ask for a sign. But no city that was destroyed before them believed.

The messengers before were only men who received revelation. They ate food and did not live forever. Allah kept His promise, saved them and destroyed the wrongdoers. He sent down a Book that mentions you, so will you not think? He destroyed many unjust cities and brought other peoples after them.

hardWords.m: not paying attention because of other things

147.title: Truth Crushes Falsehood; Allah Has No Partner

paragraphs.text: When the people of those cities felt Allah's punishment, they ran away. They were told not to run but to return to their comforts and homes, to be questioned. They cried, "We were wrongdoers!" They kept saying this until they were like a cut-down harvest, with their fire gone out.

Allah did not create the heavens and earth for play. He throws truth against falsehood, and truth crushes it, and it disappears. Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him. Those near Him are never too proud to worship Him, and they never grow tired. They praise Him night and day without stopping.

Have people taken gods from the earth who can raise the dead? If there were other gods besides Allah, the heavens and earth would be ruined. Allah, Lord of the Throne, is far above what they describe. No one questions what He does, but they will be questioned. Say, "Bring your proof." Every messenger was told, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
